#### Server errors & conditional fields

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeForm } from '@oge-ui/react-forms';
import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons';
import type { OgeFormHandle, OgeFormItemDefinition } from '@oge-ui/react-forms';

interface Registration {
  kind: string;
  company: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  confirm: string;
}

const items: OgeFormItemDefinition[] = [
  {
    field: 'kind',
    editorType: 'radioGroup',
    editorOptions: {
      items: [{ id: 'person', text: 'Person' }, { id: 'company', text: 'Company' }],
      valueExpr: 'id',
      displayExpr: 'text',
    },
  },
  {
    field: 'company',
    // shown — and required — only for companies; hidden items are not validated
    visibleWhen: { field: 'kind', equals: 'company' },
    requiredWhen: { field: 'kind', equals: 'company' },
  },
  { field: 'email', isRequired: true },
  { field: 'password', isRequired: true },
  { field: 'confirm', validationRules: [{ type: 'compare', comparisonTarget: 'password' }] },
];

export function FormServerErrorsDemo() {
  const form = useRef<OgeFormHandle<Registration>>(null);
  const [data, setData] = useState<Registration>({
    kind: 'person',
    company: '',
    email: '',
    password: '',
    confirm: '',
  });
  return (
    <OgeForm
      ref={form}
      formData={data}
      onFormDataChange={setData}
      items={items}
      showValidationSummary
      onSubmitted={async ({ data: submitted }) => {
        const response = await fetch('/api/register', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: JSON.stringify(submitted),
        });
        // e.g. { email: ['This email is already registered'] } — shown in the
        // field and the summary, cleared as soon as the user edits the field
        if (!response.ok) form.current?.setErrors(await response.json());
      }}
      actions={<OgeButton text="Register" stylingMode="contained" useSubmitBehavior />}
    />
  );
}
```

## @oge-ui/react-upload

React file upload: drag & drop with directory and paste support, client-side restrictions that stay on the row with their reason, image previews and a lightbox, per-file progress with rate and ETA, chunked resumable transfer with pause, resume and retry, a pluggable transport adapter, external drop zones and triggers — running the same upload engine, list machine and stylesheet as the Angular upload package.

Docs: https://www.ogeui.com/components/upload

### <OgeFileUploader>

#### Properties

_Selection_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | `string` | `''` | The `accept` attribute of the file input. Also filters drops and pastes, which the browser does not do for you. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `true` | Allows several files. With `false` a new selection _replaces_ the list, which is what every reference does. |
| `directory` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets the dialog pick a folder, and descends into dropped folders. Falls back to the flat file list where the entry API is unavailable. |
| `pastable` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds files from a paste while the uploader has focus — a pasted screenshot included. |
| `allowDrop` | `boolean` | `true` | Turns drag & drop off without hiding the browse affordance. |
| `dropZone` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Name this uploader answers to, so `<OgeUploadDropZone>` and `<OgeUploadTrigger>` elsewhere can reach it. dx `dropZone`, Kendo `zoneId`, Syncfusion `dropArea`. |
| `dropEffect` | `'copy' \| 'move' \| 'link' \| 'none' \| 'default'` | `'copy'` | Pointer feedback while files hover the zone. |
| `fieldName` | `string` | `'files[]'` | Multipart field name, and the `name` attribute of the file input — Kendo’s `saveField`. |
| `openFileDialogOnClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Ant’s option. `false` makes the zone drop-only — and stops it being a button, because a button that does nothing on Enter is worse than none; the separate browse button appears instead so the keyboard path survives. |
| `capture` | `boolean \| 'user' \| 'environment'` | `undefined` | The native `capture` attribute: opens the camera or microphone directly on mobile instead of the file browser. |
| `transformFile` | `((file: File) => File \| Promise<File>) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Rewrites each file — compression, watermarking, EXIF stripping. Applied _before_ validation, so the restrictions judge the bytes that will be sent. |
| `thumbnailFor` | `((file: OgeUploadFile) => string \| null \| Promise<string \| null>) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Supplies a preview the browser cannot make itself — a server-rendered PDF thumbnail, a downscaled canvas image. Returning `null` is the "not an image" half. |
| `inputAttributes` | `Record<string, string>` | `{}` | Extra attributes for the internal file input, applied imperatively. |

_Restrictions_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowedFileExtensions` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | `.png`-style or bare `png`-style; empty allows everything. |
| `maxFileSize / minFileSize` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Inclusive bounds in bytes. `undefined` means no limit — an explicit `0` is a real limit. |
| `maxFileCount` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Only the files past the limit are rejected, and a rejected file never spends a count slot. |
| `maxTotalFileSize` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Budget across the whole list. **OGE extra**. |
| `validateFile` | `((file: File) => string \| null) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Returns a message to reject, or `null` to accept — the validation half of Ant’s `beforeUpload`. |

_Transport_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uploadUrl` | `string \| ((files: readonly File[]) => string)` | `''` | Empty means there is nowhere to send to, and nothing is sent — the uploader stays a picker. |
| `uploadMode` | `'instantly' \| 'useButtons' \| 'useForm' \| 'select'` | `'instantly'` | `select` never uploads: Kendo’s FileSelect as a mode rather than a second component. |
| `uploadMethod / uploadHeaders / uploadCustomData` | `'post' \| 'put' \| 'patch' / Record / Record \| fn` | `'post' / {} / {}` | `uploadCustomData` also takes a per-file function — Ant’s `data` in both shapes. |
| `withCredentials / responseType / timeout` | `boolean / 'json' \| 'text' \| 'blob' / number` | `false / json / undefined` | Standard request knobs. |
| `batch` | `boolean` | `false` | Every file in one request. |
| `concurrency` | `number \| undefined` | `3 (config)` | One number replaces two booleans: Kendo’s `concurrent: false` and Syncfusion’s `sequentialUpload: true` are both `1`. |
| `chunk` | `boolean \| OgeUploadChunkOptions` | `false` | Kendo’s `ChunkSettings` defaults: `size: 1 MiB`, `autoRetryAfter: 100`, `maxAutoRetries: 1`, `resumable: true`. |
| `autoRetry` | `boolean \| OgeUploadRetryOptions` | `false` | Whole-file retry; defaults `{ count: 3, delayMs: 500 }`. A run serving its backoff frees its concurrency slot. |
| `uploadAdapter` | `OgeUploadAdapter \| undefined` | `undefined` | Replaces the transport wholesale for this instance; `<OgeUploadTransportProvider>` does it for a subtree. |
| `abortable` | `boolean` | `true` | dx’s `allowCanceling`. |
| `removeUrl / removeMethod / removeHeaders / removeField` | `string / 'post' \| 'delete' / Record / string` | `undefined / 'post' / {} / 'fileNames'` | Server-side delete. Only files that actually reached the server are deleted there. |

_Display_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `displayMode` | `'full' \| 'compact' \| 'button'` | `'full'` | PrimeNG’s advanced/basic pair, plus a slim `compact` bar (**OGE extra**). |
| `showFileList` | `boolean \| OgeUploadFileListOptions` | `true` | The boolean, or Ant’s options object (`showRemove`, `showRetry`, `showCancel`, `showPause`, …). |
| `listType / previewWidth` | `'text' \| 'picture' \| 'pictureCard' / number` | `'text' / 50` | Preview rendering. |
| `actionsLayout` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'stretch'` | `'end'` | Where the action row sits. |
| `showUploadButton / showClearButton / showCancelButton` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | `undefined` derives visibility from `uploadMode` — no button that has nothing to do. |
| `initialFiles` | `readonly OgeUploadPreloadedFile[]` | `[]` | Files that already live on the server — Syncfusion’s `files`, Ant’s `defaultFileList`. |
| `messages` | `OgeUploadMessagesInput` | `undefined` | Per-instance override, layered over `<OgeUploadConfigProvider>`. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the uploader host. |

_State and forms_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `readonly File[]` | `[]` | Every row that carries a real `File`, **including invalid ones** — controlled when provided, so pass `onValueChange` with it. Hiding invalid rows would let `required` pass while a file is plainly on screen; the handle’s `valid` flag is what blocks submission. |
| `defaultValue` | `readonly File[]` | `[]` | Uncontrolled initial value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(files: readonly File[]) => void` | `—` | The controlled half of `value`; Angular’s `[(value)]` model is both halves at once. |
| `disabled / readOnly / required / invalid / touched / dirty / name / errors` | `FormValueControl contract` | `—` | The same member names the Angular Signal Forms contract fixes — here plain props; `<OgeForm>` drives them for its `fileUploader` editor. |
| `files` | `readonly OgeUploadFile[] (handle)` | `—` | Read off the `ref` handle. Every row, invalid and preloaded included. |
| `progress / busy / uploadedCount / fileCount / limitExceeded / valid / validationErrors` | `handle getters` | `—` | Read off the `ref` handle — Angular exposes the same names as signals. Replaces dx’s `progress`/`isValid`/`validationErrors` and PrimeNG’s boolean methods. |

#### Methods

_OgeFileUploader_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `upload(uids?)` | `void` | Starts the queued transfers. Files that failed a restriction are never sent. |
| `abort(uid?, reason?)` | `void` | dx `abortUpload`, Kendo `cancelUploadByUid`. |
| `pause(uid) / resume(uid)` | `boolean` | Chunked and resumable transfers only; returns `false` otherwise rather than aborting and calling it a pause. |
| `retry(uid?)` | `void` | With no argument, everything that failed or was aborted. |
| `addFiles(files)` | `void` | Adds files through the same pipeline as a drop. |
| `removeFile(uid) / clear()` | `void` | Both run their cancelable pre-event first. |
| `openFileDialog()` | `void` | PrimeNG `choose`. |
| `getFiles(index?) / sortFiles(compare?)` | `readonly OgeUploadFile[] / void` | Syncfusion `getFilesData` / `sortFileList`; sorts by name unless told otherwise. |
| `preview(uid) / download(uid)` | `void` | Opens the built-in lightbox / downloads the file. Both fire a cancelable callback first, so an app can substitute its own viewer or signed-URL flow — Ant’s `onPreview` and `onDownload`. |
| `reset(value?)` | `void` | dx’s `reset`: back to a pristine state. Fires no `onClearing` pipeline — a reset is the app rewinding its form, not the user removing files. |
| `focus() / blur()` | `void` | Moves focus to the browse affordance. |
| `formatFileSize(bytes, options?)` | `string` | Exported free function — PrimeNG `formatSize`, Syncfusion `bytesToSize`. |

#### Events

_Selection_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onFilesSelecting` | `(event: OgeUploadFilesSelectingEvent) => void` | **Cancelable** (set `event.cancel`). Before anything is validated or added. Carries the source: dialog, drop, paste or api. |
| `onFilesSelected / onFileRejected / onFilesDropped` | `callback` | `onFileRejected` fires once per file that failed a restriction — **OGE extra**; the references only render a message. |
| `onDropZoneEntered / onDropZoneLeft` | `(event: OgeUploadDropZoneEvent) => void` | dx `onDropZoneEnter` / `onDropZoneLeave`. |

_Transfers_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onUploading` | `(event: OgeUploadUploadingEvent) => void` | **Cancelable**, and the one place the outgoing `request` is writable — dx’s `onBeforeSend`. |
| `onUploadStarted / onUploadProgress / onUploaded / onUploadFailed / onUploadAborted / onAllUploaded` | `callback` | `onUploadStarted` fires when a request actually goes out — not when the file is queued, and again on a retry. |
| `onChunkUploading / onChunkUploaded / onChunkFailed` | `callback` | `onChunkUploading` is cancelable, per slice. |
| `onUploadPausing / onUploadPaused / onUploadResuming / onUploadResumed` | `callback` | The `-ing` halves are cancelable. |

_List_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onFileRemoving / onFileRemoved` | `callback` | `onFileRemoving` is cancelable and reports whether a server delete will follow. |
| `onClearing / onCleared` | `callback` | `onClearing` is cancelable. |
| `onPreviewShowing / onPreviewHidden` | `callback` | `onPreviewShowing` is cancelable — veto it to open your own viewer instead of the built-in lightbox. |
| `onFileDownloading` | `(event: OgeUploadFileDownloadingEvent) => void` | Cancelable. The default is an anchor click against the server `url`, or a temporary object URL for a file that only exists locally. |
| `onThumbnailFailed / onValueChange / onTouch` | `callback` | Preview decode failure, the controlled value, and the forms contract (fires once per interaction that dirties the control). |

#### Types

_Types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeUploadFile` | `interface` | `uid`, `name`, `size`, `type`, `file`, `status`, `loaded`, `progress`, `errors`, `response`, `httpStatus`, `chunk`, `attempts`, plus `bytesPerSecond` and `secondsRemaining` (**OGE extra**). Shared with the Angular package via `@oge-ui/behavior`. |
| `OgeUploadFileStatus` | `union` | `'pending' \| 'uploading' \| 'paused' \| 'uploaded' \| 'failed' \| 'aborted' \| 'invalid' \| 'removed'`. |
| `OgeUploadAdapter` | `interface` | `send(parts, request, callbacks)` and optional `remove(...)`. Batch versus per-file is the shape of the argument, not a flag. |
| `OgeUploadChunkMetadata` | `interface` | Kendo’s `ChunkMetadata` field for field, so a Kendo-shaped server needs no changes. |
| `<OgeUploadTransportProvider adapter>` | `component` | The default adapter for a subtree — the counterpart of Angular’s `OGE_UPLOAD_TRANSPORT` token. Override it in tests and demos; jsdom’s XHR performs real network I/O. |
| `<OgeUploadConfigProvider config>` | `component` | App-wide defaults and messages — five nested message blocks: buttons, dropZone, status, validation, announcements. Messages render through `ogeFormatMessage` in the config `locale`, so count messages are ICU plurals (`filesAdded: {count, plural, one {# file added} other {# files added}}`). The counterpart of `provideOgeUploadConfig()`. |
| `<OgeUploadDropZone zone>` | `component` | Turns its element into a drop target for the uploader whose `dropZone` matches the given name. Reports hover through `onOverChange` for your own styling. |
| `<OgeUploadTrigger zone>` | `component` | A real `<button>` that opens an uploader’s file dialog from elsewhere on the page — dx’s `dialogTrigger`. Disables itself while no uploader answers to that name. |
| `createXhrUploadAdapter()` | `() => OgeUploadAdapter` | The default transport. Exported so a custom adapter can delegate to it. |
| `OgeFileUploaderHandle` | `ref handle` | Every public method above plus the read-only getters `files`, `valid`, `validationErrors`, `busy`, `progress`, `uploadedCount`, `fileCount`, `limitExceeded`. |

_Template directives (render props)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderFile` | `(context: OgeUploadFileRenderContext) => ReactNode` | Replaces one file row — the React face of `*ogeUploadFileTemplate`. Context: `file`, `index`, and the pre-formatted `size` and `status`. |
| `renderHeader` | `(context: OgeUploadHeaderRenderContext) => ReactNode` | Replaces the strip above the list — `*ogeUploadHeaderTemplate`. Context: `files`, `count`, `uploadedCount` and a pre-formatted `totalSize`. |
| `renderDropZone` | `(context: OgeUploadDropZoneRenderContext) => ReactNode` | Replaces the drop zone’s contents — `*ogeUploadDropZoneTemplate`. Context: `over` (`true` while files hover) and `disabled`. |
| `renderEmpty` | `() => ReactNode` | Rendered in place of the list while nothing is selected — `*ogeUploadEmptyTemplate`. |
| `renderToolbar` | `(context: OgeUploadToolbarRenderContext) => ReactNode` | Replaces the Upload/Clear action row — `*ogeUploadToolbarTemplate`. Context: `files` and `uploading`. |
| `renderIcon` | `(slot: OgeUploadIconSlot) => ReactNode` | Replaces one glyph — `*ogeUploadIconTemplate`. The slot is one of 14 values covering PrimeNG’s four icon slots and Ant’s three, in one render prop instead of seven. |

### Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

#### Getting started

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeFileUploader } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function AttachmentsPicker() {
  const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState<readonly File[]>([]);
  return (
    <>
      {/* With no uploadUrl this is a file picker: drag & drop, restrictions,
          previews and removal, with everything chosen exposed through the
          controlled value as plain File objects. Add uploadUrl and the same
          element uploads. */}
      <OgeFileUploader
        value={attachments}
        onValueChange={setAttachments}
        accept="image/*,.pdf"
        maxFileSize={5 * 1024 * 1024}
        maxFileCount={5}
      />

      <p>{attachments.length} file(s) ready</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Uploading

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeFileUploader } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function UploadForm() {
  // uploadMode decides when bytes move: 'instantly' on selection,
  // 'useButtons' waits for the Upload button, 'select' never uploads.
  // Progress, cancel and retry appear on each row as the transfer needs them.
  const onUploaded = (name: string, response: unknown) => console.log('uploaded', name, response);
  const onFailed = (name: string, message: string) => console.warn('failed', name, message);
  return (
    <OgeFileUploader
      uploadUrl="/api/upload"
      uploadMode="useButtons"
      uploadHeaders={{ Authorization: 'Bearer demo' }}
      concurrency={2}
      onUploaded={(e) => onUploaded(e.file.name, e.response)}
      onUploadFailed={(e) => onFailed(e.file.name, e.message)}
    />
  );
}
```

#### Chunked and resumable

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeFileUploader } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function ChunkedUpload() {
  // Chunked transfer sends one slice per request, carrying Kendo-shaped
  // metadata so an existing chunked endpoint needs no changes. Pause and
  // resume appear only here: a whole-file request has nothing to suspend,
  // so the affordance is derived from the transport rather than configured.
  const onChunk = (index: number, total: number) => console.log(`chunk ${index + 1} of ${total}`);
  return (
    <OgeFileUploader
      uploadUrl="/api/upload"
      chunk={{ size: 512 * 1024, maxAutoRetries: 2, resumable: true }}
      autoRetry={{ count: 2, delayMs: 400 }}
      onChunkUploaded={(e) => onChunk(e.chunkIndex, e.totalChunks)}
    />
  );
}
```

#### Restrictions

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeFileUploader } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function RestrictedPicker() {
  const [lastRejection, setLastRejection] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /** Returns a message to reject, or null to accept. */
  const noSpaces = (file: File): string | null =>
    file.name.includes(' ') ? 'File names must not contain spaces.' : null;
  return (
    <>
      {/* A rejected file stays on the list with its reason next to it, rather
          than vanishing. It is still in value — hiding it would let a required
          field pass while the user can plainly see a file on screen — and the
          handle's valid flag is what goes false. */}
      <OgeFileUploader
        allowedFileExtensions={['.png', '.jpg', '.pdf']}
        maxFileSize={1024 * 1024}
        minFileSize={1024}
        maxTotalFileSize={4 * 1024 * 1024}
        validateFile={noSpaces}
        onFileRejected={(e) => setLastRejection(e.errors[0].message)}
      />

      {lastRejection && <p role="status">{lastRejection}</p>}
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Previews

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeFileUploader } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function PicturePicker() {
  return (
    // listType renders previews instead of a text row. The object URLs
    // behind them are owned by the component and revoked on remove, clear
    // and unmount.
    <OgeFileUploader accept="image/*" listType="pictureCard" previewWidth={96} />
  );
}
```

#### External drop zone

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeFileUploader, OgeUploadDropZone, OgeUploadTrigger } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function PanelUpload() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* The drop surface is often a whole panel that has nothing to do with
          the uploader's own markup. That is a different element, which no mode
          value can express — hence a wrapper, matched by name. */}
      <OgeUploadDropZone zone="attachments" className="panel">
        Drop files anywhere in this panel
      </OgeUploadDropZone>

      <OgeUploadTrigger zone="attachments">Attach files…</OgeUploadTrigger>

      <OgeFileUploader dropZone="attachments" displayMode="compact" />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Controlled value & forms

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeFileUploader } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';
import type { OgeFileUploaderHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function RequiredAttachments() {
  // The restrictions live on the uploader, so a form never restates
  // maxFileSize as a second rule that could drift: read the handle's
  // valid flag (or onFileRejected) and block submission on it. The same
  // component is the fileUploader editor of <OgeForm> (@oge-ui/react-forms).
  const uploader = useRef<OgeFileUploaderHandle>(null);
  const [attachments, setAttachments] = useState<readonly File[]>([]);
  const [valid, setValid] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeFileUploader
        ref={uploader}
        value={attachments}
        onValueChange={(files) => {
          setAttachments(files);
          setValid(uploader.current?.valid ?? false);
        }}
        maxFileSize={1024 * 1024}
        required
      />

      <p>valid: {String(valid)}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Templates

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeFileUploader } from '@oge-ui/react-upload';

export function CustomRows() {
  return (
    // Six render props replace any part of the rendering. The row context
    // arrives pre-formatted, so a custom row needs no size formatter of its own.
    <OgeFileUploader
      accept="image/*"
      renderFile={({ file, size, status }) => (
        <>
          <strong>{file.name}</strong>
          <span>{size} · {status}</span>
        </>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

## @oge-ui/react-editor

React rich-text editor: a dependency-free contenteditable editor over its own document model (no execCommand) with headings, lists, quotes, code, links, images, colours and alignment, its own undo history, markdown shortcuts, Word / Google Docs paste cleanup, a strict allowlist HTML sanitizer and an APG toolbar — running the same editor machine and stylesheet as the Angular editor package.

Docs: https://www.ogeui.com/components/editor

### <OgeEditor>

#### Properties

_Value and forms_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | `undefined` | The sanitized HTML value — controlled when provided (pair it with `onValueChange`), `defaultValue` for uncontrolled use. The empty string when the document is empty. The editor ignores its own echo, so the caret and the history survive a controlled round trip. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | Uncontrolled initial value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | `—` | Every change of the value — the controlled half of `value`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Not editable and out of the Tab order (`aria-disabled`). |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Focusable and selectable, but not editable (`aria-readonly`); every tool is disabled. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-required` and the asterisk; validation is the form library’s. |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Written as `data-name` on the editing surface. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | External invalid state (from your form library). |
| `touched / dirty` | `boolean` | `false` | External touched / dirty state; errors show once the field is touched. |
| `errors` | `readonly OgeFieldError[]` | `[]` | Validation errors to show (the first one’s message, or the matching catalog string). |
| `maxLength` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` | Most characters (grapheme clusters) of _text_ the document may hold. Typing and pasting stop there (announced), the counter shows the budget, and a longer external value shows the error. |

_Chrome_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible label above the editor; also its accessible name (`aria-labelledby`). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Accessible name when there is no visible label; falls back to `messages.editorLabel`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Shown while the document is empty; also `aria-placeholder`. |
| `hint` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Helper text under the editor, hidden while an error shows; part of `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorText` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Explicit error message — always wins over the resolved messages. |
| `counter` | `'none' \| 'characters' \| 'words' \| 'both'` | `'none'` | Character / word counter under the editor (ICU plurals from `messages.counter`). With `maxLength` the character count reads `12 / 200`. |
| `toolbar` | `readonly OgeEditorToolbarEntry[] \| false \| undefined` | `undefined` | Toolbar entries: built-in tool names, `'separator'` and `OgeEditorCustomTool` objects. `undefined` is the full default toolbar, `false` hides it. |
| `toolbarOverflow` | `'menu' \| 'scroll' \| 'wrap' \| 'extended' \| 'none'` | `'menu'` | What the toolbar does with tools that do not fit (the layout toolbar’s `overflow`). |
| `height / minHeight / maxHeight` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Size of the editing area — a number is px, a string any CSS length. Without them the area starts at 160px and grows with its content. |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a vertical resize handle to the editing area. |
| `spellcheck` | `boolean` | `true` | The browser’s spell checking on the editing surface. |
| `tabIndex` | `number` | `0` | Tab index of the editing surface. |
| `autofocus` | `boolean` | `false` | Focuses the editor after it mounts. |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Base of the generated element ids; defaults to one derived from `useId()` (SSR-safe). |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `undefined` | Classes and inline style of the host element. |

_Behaviour (undefined = config)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `markdownShortcuts` | `boolean \| undefined` | `true` | `#`…`######`, `-`, `1.`, `>`, ````` at the start of a paragraph and `---` + Enter turn into formats. One undo brings the typed characters back. |
| `pasteMode` | `'html' \| 'text' \| undefined` | `'html'` | `'html'` keeps (sanitized) formatting from the clipboard; `'text'` inserts text only. |
| `headingLevels` | `readonly OgeEditorHeadingLevel[] \| undefined` | `[1, 2, 3, 4]` | Heading levels the block-format menu offers. |
| `textColors / backgroundColors` | `OgeColorPalettePreset \| readonly string[] \| undefined` | `'default'` | Palettes of the two colour popups — an `@oge-ui/react-inputs` palette preset or your own colour list. Colours are validated (no `url()`, `var()` or expressions). |
| `allowedSchemes` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `[]` | Extra link schemes on top of `sanitizeUrl`’s allowlist (`http`, `https`, `mailto`, `tel`, `ftp`, `sms`). Script schemes can never be allowed. |
| `allowDataImages` | `boolean \| undefined` | `false` | Keep `data:image/*` sources (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP — never SVG). `blob:` and `file:` images are always dropped. |
| `messages` | `OgeEditorMessagesInput \| undefined` | `undefined` | Per-instance overrides of the user-facing strings, merged group by group over the `<OgeEditorConfigProvider>` values. |

_Read-only state_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `activeState` | `OgeEditorActiveState` | Handle getter: the formats under the selection — what the toolbar shows. |
| `characterCount / wordCount` | `number` | Handle getters: grapheme clusters and words (`Intl.Segmenter`) of the text. |
| `canUndo / canRedo` | `boolean` | Handle getters: whether the history has a step back / forward. |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeEditorHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus()` | `void` | Moves focus into the editing area and restores the caret. |
| `blur()` | `void` | Removes keyboard focus. |
| `exec(command)` | `(command: OgeEditorCommandName \| OgeEditorCommand) => boolean` | Runs a command — a name (`'bold'`, `'heading2'`, `'bulletList'`…) or a command object (`{ type: 'color', color: '#c00' }`). Returns `true` when it changed something. |
| `undo() / redo()` | `() => boolean` | Steps through the editor’s own history. |
| `insertText(text)` | `(text: string) => void` | Inserts plain text at the selection (newlines become paragraphs). |
| `insertHtml(html)` | `(html: string) => void` | Inserts HTML at the selection — parsed through the editor’s allowlist first, like a paste. |
| `insertLink(href, text?, newTab?)` | `(href: string, text?: string, newTab?: boolean) => boolean` | Links the selection, or inserts `text` (default: the address) as a link. Unsafe addresses are refused (`false`); new-tab links get `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. |
| `removeLink()` | `() => boolean` | Removes the link under the selection or around the caret. |
| `insertImage(src, alt?)` | `(src: string, alt?: string) => boolean` | Inserts an image by URL; unsafe sources are refused. |
| `selectAll()` | `void` | Selects the whole document. |
| `getHtml() / getText()` | `() => string` | The current value, or its text with blocks separated by newlines. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Empties the editor as one undoable change. |
| `reset(value?)` | `(value?: string) => void` | Loads `value` (default: empty), clears the history and the touched / dirty state, and reports the change. |
| `openLinkDialog() / openImageDialog()` | `() => Promise<void>` | Opens the link or image prompt for the selection (also Ctrl+K and the toolbar tools), subject to `onDialogOpening`. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onValueCommitted` | `(event: OgeEditorValueCommittedEvent) => void` | Every committed change: `{ value, previousValue, event }`. |
| `onFocus / onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent) => void` | Focus entered or left the editor (popups included). |
| `onSelectionChange` | `(event: OgeEditorSelectionChangedEvent) => void` | The selection moved or its formats changed: `{ active }`. |
| `onCommandExecuted` | `(event: OgeEditorCommandExecutedEvent) => void` | A command ran (keyboard, toolbar or `exec`): `{ command, event }`. |
| `onToolClick` | `(event: OgeEditorToolClickEvent) => void` | A toolbar tool was activated: `{ key, inMenu, event }`. |
| `onPasting` | `(event: OgeEditorPastingEvent) => void` | Cancelable: a paste or drop is about to be inserted. Set `cancel`, or rewrite `html` / `text`. |
| `onDialogOpening` | `(event: OgeEditorDialogOpeningEvent) => void` | Cancelable: the link or image dialog is about to open (`{ kind, link, cancel }`). Cancel it to show your own dialog, then call `insertLink()` / `insertImage()` on the handle. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeEditorToolName` | `'undo' \| 'redo' \| 'blockFormat' \| 'bold' \| 'italic' \| 'underline' \| 'strike' \| 'code' \| 'subscript' \| 'superscript' \| 'textColor' \| 'backgroundColor' \| 'link' \| 'unlink' \| 'image' \| 'bulletList' \| 'orderedList' \| 'indent' \| 'outdent' \| 'blockquote' \| 'codeBlock' \| 'horizontalRule' \| 'alignStart' \| 'alignCenter' \| 'alignEnd' \| 'alignJustify' \| 'directionLtr' \| 'directionRtl' \| 'clearFormatting'` | Built-in toolbar tools. `OGE_DEFAULT_EDITOR_TOOLBAR` is the default arrangement. |
| `OgeEditorToolbarEntry` | `OgeEditorToolName \| 'separator' \| OgeEditorCustomTool` | One toolbar entry. Leading, trailing and doubled separators are dropped. |
| `OgeEditorCustomTool` | `{ key; text; icon?; hint?; shortcut?; isActive?(active); isDisabled?(active); run(context: OgeEditorToolContext) }` | A tool of your own. `isActive` makes it a toggle (`aria-pressed`); `run` receives `exec`, `insertHtml`, `insertText`, `getHtml` and the active state. |
| `OgeEditorCommandName` | `'bold' \| 'italic' \| … \| 'heading1'…'heading6' \| 'blockquote' \| 'codeBlock' \| 'bulletList' \| 'orderedList' \| 'indent' \| 'outdent' \| 'alignStart' \| 'alignCenter' \| 'alignEnd' \| 'alignJustify' \| 'horizontalRule' \| 'clearFormatting' \| 'unlink' \| 'undo' \| 'redo' \| 'selectAll'` | Parameterless commands by name, for `exec()`. |
| `OgeEditorCommand` | `{ type: 'toggleMark'; mark } \| { type: 'blockFormat'; format; level? } \| { type: 'list'; list } \| { type: 'align'; align } \| { type: 'color' \| 'background'; color } \| { type: 'link'; href; text?; newTab? } \| { type: 'image'; src; alt? } \| …` | A command object — the same vocabulary the toolbar and the keyboard map issue. |
| `OgeEditorActiveState` | `{ marks; blockFormat; list; align; dir; link; color; background; canIndent; canOutdent; collapsed }` | What the selection currently is. |
| `OgeEditorMessages` | `interface` | Every user-facing string: tool names, block names, dialogs, colours, counter (ICU plurals), announcements, validation and key names. Translated in all ten `@oge-ui/locales` packs (`<OgeLocaleProvider>` wires them). |
| `OgeEditorConfigProvider` | `({ config?: OgeEditorConfigInput; children }) => ReactNode` | Subtree-wide defaults and strings; nested providers merge over the outer one. |
| `ogeSanitizeEditorHtml(html, options?)` | `(html: string \| null \| undefined, options?: OgeEditorParseOptions) => string` | The editor’s allowlist as a function — for values that did not come through the editor. Only the editor’s own tags and attributes come out. Works on a server too: without `DOMParser` the editor’s own tokenizer reads the markup (the same one that server-renders the editing surface). |
| `ogeEditorHtmlLength(html)` | `(html: string \| null \| undefined, options?: OgeEditorParseOptions) => number` | Characters of an HTML value’s text — the measure `maxLength` applies; use it in your form library’s validator. |
| `ogeEditorCommandFromName(name)` | `(name: OgeEditorCommandName) => OgeEditorCommand` | Expands a command name into its command object. |
| `OGE_EDITOR_TRUSTED_TYPES_POLICY` | `'oge-ui#editor'` | Name of the Trusted Types policy behind the editor’s one `DOMParser` call. List it in a `trusted-types` CSP directive. |
| `useOgeEditorConfig() / OGE_DEFAULT_EDITOR_CONFIG / OGE_DEFAULT_EDITOR_MESSAGES` | `() => OgeEditorConfig / OgeEditorConfig / OgeEditorMessages` | The resolved config of the subtree, and the shipped defaults. |
| `OGE_DEFAULT_EDITOR_TOOLBAR` | `readonly OgeEditorToolbarEntry[]` | The default toolbar arrangement — spread it to extend the default instead of replacing it. |

### Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

#### Getting started

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeEditor } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

export function DescriptionEditor() {
  // The value is sanitized HTML ('' when empty). Every edit is a command on
  // the editor's own document model — no document.execCommand — so every
  // browser produces the same markup, and undo is the editor's own history.
  const [html, setHtml] = useState('<p>Hello <strong>world</strong></p>');
  return (
    <>
      <OgeEditor
        label="Description"
        placeholder="Write something…"
        hint="Try Ctrl+B, Ctrl+K, or type “# ” at the start of a line."
        value={html}
        onValueChange={setHtml}
      />
      <pre>{html}</pre>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Toolbar and custom tools

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeEditor } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';
import type { OgeEditorCustomTool, OgeEditorToolbarEntry } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

// A custom tool: a label, an optional 16×16 stroke icon, and what it does.
const stamp: OgeEditorCustomTool = {
  key: 'stamp',
  text: 'Insert today’s date',
  icon: 'M3 4.5h10v9H3zM3 7.5h10M6 2.5v3M10 2.5v3',
  run: (editor) => editor.insertText(new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB')),
};

// Built-in tool names, 'separator' and your own tools, in any order.
const tools: readonly OgeEditorToolbarEntry[] = [
  'undo', 'redo', 'separator', 'blockFormat', 'bold', 'italic', 'separator',
  'bulletList', 'orderedList', 'separator', 'link', stamp,
];

export function ReleaseNotes() {
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('<h3>1.2.0</h3><ul><li>New rich-text editor</li></ul>');
  return (
    <OgeEditor label="Release notes" toolbar={tools} value={notes} onValueChange={setNotes} />
  );
}
```

#### Keyboard and markdown

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeEditor } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

export function MeetingNotes() {
  // Markdown shortcuts: "# " … "###### ", "- ", "1. ", "> ", "``` " at the start
  // of a paragraph, and "---" + Enter for a horizontal line. One undo brings the
  // typed characters back. Tab / Shift+Tab nest list items; Tab anywhere else
  // leaves the editor, so the keyboard is never trapped.
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  return (
    <OgeEditor
      label="Meeting notes"
      markdownShortcuts
      headingLevels={[1, 2, 3]}
      value={notes}
      onValueChange={setNotes}
    />
  );
}
```

#### Links and images

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeEditor } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';
import type { OgeEditorHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

export function ArticleEditor() {
  // The link and image tools open the overlay's prompt dialog; the handle does
  // the same from code. A javascript: link is refused, and "ogeui.com" typed
  // into the dialog becomes https://ogeui.com instead of a relative link.
  const editor = useRef<OgeEditorHandle>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeEditor ref={editor} label="Article" defaultValue="<p>Read the docs.</p>" />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => editor.current?.insertLink('https://www.ogeui.com', 'OGE UI')}>
        Insert a link
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => editor.current?.insertImage('/favicon.ico', 'OGE logo')}>
        Insert an image
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void editor.current?.openLinkDialog()}>
        Open the link dialog
      </button>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Paste and sanitizing

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeEditor, ogeSanitizeEditorHtml } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';
import type { OgeEditorPastingEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

// The same sanitizer, for HTML that did not come through the editor.
const clean = ogeSanitizeEditorHtml(
  '<p>Hi <a href="javascript:alert(1)">there</a><img src=x onerror=alert(1)></p><script>alert(1)</script>',
);

// onPasting is cancelable and may rewrite the payload.
const onPasting = (event: OgeEditorPastingEvent) => {
  event.cancel = event.html.includes('1x1.gif');
};

export function PasteTarget() {
  const [pasted, setPasted] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      <OgeEditor label="Paste here" pasteMode="html" onPasting={onPasting} value={pasted} onValueChange={setPasted} />
      <pre>{clean}</pre>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Controlled value and validation

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeEditor, ogeEditorHtmlLength } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

export function SummaryField() {
  // maxLength stops typing and pasting at 200 characters of text and the
  // counter shows the budget. In your form library, validate with
  // ogeEditorHtmlLength() — the string length would count the HTML markup.
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState('');
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);
  const valid = summary !== '' && ogeEditorHtmlLength(summary) <= 200;
  return (
    <>
      <OgeEditor
        label="Summary"
        required
        maxLength={200}
        counter="characters"
        value={summary}
        onValueChange={setSummary}
        onBlur={() => setTouched(true)}
        touched={touched}
        invalid={!valid}
      />
      <p>valid: {String(valid)}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Read-only, sizing and counter

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeEditor } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

export function TermsEditor() {
  // readonly keeps the text focusable and selectable; disabled takes the
  // editor out of the Tab order. height / minHeight / maxHeight take px or
  // any CSS length; resizable adds a vertical resize handle.
  const [readonly, setReadonly] = useState(false);
  const [disabled, setDisabled] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={readonly} onChange={() => setReadonly(!readonly)} /> Read-only
      </label>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={disabled} onChange={() => setDisabled(!disabled)} /> Disabled
      </label>
      <OgeEditor
        label="Terms"
        readonly={readonly}
        disabled={disabled}
        minHeight={120}
        maxHeight={260}
        resizable
        counter="both"
        defaultValue="<h3>Terms</h3><p>By using this service you agree to <em>everything</em>.</p>"
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Configuration

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeEditor, OgeEditorConfigProvider } from '@oge-ui/react-editor';

export function ConfiguredEditors() {
  // Subtree-wide defaults and strings (<OgeLocaleProvider> covers the strings
  // too). A page with require-trusted-types-for 'script' lists the editor's
  // policy: trusted-types oge-ui#editor
  return (
    <OgeEditorConfigProvider
      config={{
        headingLevels: [2, 3],
        pasteMode: 'html',
        markdownShortcuts: true,
        textColors: 'office',
        messages: { tools: { bold: 'Kalın', italic: 'İtalik' } },
      }}
    >
      <OgeEditor label="Notes" />
    </OgeEditorConfigProvider>
  );
}
```

## @oge-ui/react-kanban

React Kanban board: columns + swimlanes over a plain card array with field mapping, WIP limits, per-column virtualization, drag & drop with Escape-cancel and edge auto-scroll, Ctrl+Arrow keyboard card moving with live announcements, cancelable CRUD and move callbacks, built-in edit dialog, context menu and toolbar — running the same engine and stylesheet as the Angular Kanban package.

**This package is commercially licensed — unlike the rest of the suite, it is not MIT. See https://www.ogeui.com/license before shipping it.**

Docs: https://www.ogeui.com/components/kanban

### <OgeKanban>

#### Properties

_Data_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Card items — a plain array, copied into an internal working set; the array is never mutated. A new array re-seeds the board. Edits surface through the past-tense callbacks. |
| `keyExpr / columnExpr / titleExpr / descriptionExpr / colorExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'id' / 'status' / 'title' / 'description' / 'color'` | Card field mapping: names (dotted paths reach nested objects) or getter functions. `columnExpr` holds the card's column key; a card with no resolvable column lands in the untitled column instead of being dropped. |
| `orderExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Numeric in-column sort order. Unset, the array order is the board order and moves reorder the working set; set, moves write a midpoint order value back onto the item (sequential renumber of the cell when the midpoint has no room). |
| `swimlaneExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Set = the board renders collapsible swimlane rows (first-seen data order); each lane holds every column. |
| `tagsExpr / assigneeExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Tag chips and assignee avatars (initials). Both accept a single value _or_ an array — write-back preserves the storage shape. |
| `dueDateExpr / priorityExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Due-date badge (danger when overdue; formatted through `locale`) and the priority indicator (colored by value: `'low'` green, `'medium'`/`'normal'` amber, `'high'`/`'urgent'`/`'critical'` red). |
| `searchExprs` | `readonly (string \| ((item: T) => unknown))[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Extra fields the toolbar search matches, beyond the built-in title + description + tags + assignees haystack. Matching is fold-insensitive (accents, Turkish İ/i). |
| `columns` | `readonly OgeKanbanColumn[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Declared columns (`{ key, title?, color?, wipLimit?, minCount?, collapsed?, allowAdding?, allowDrag?, allowDrop?, transitionColumns? }`); unset = derived from the data's distinct column keys in first-seen order. Cards in undeclared columns stay in the data but leave the view. |

_State (controlled / uncontrolled)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapsedColumns / collapsedSwimlanes` | `readonly string[]` | `uncontrolled, []` | Collapsed column keys (slim vertical pills) and collapsed swimlane keys. Controlled when provided; `defaultCollapsedColumns` / `defaultCollapsedSwimlanes` seed the uncontrolled state at mount. |
| `columnOrder` | `readonly string[]` | `uncontrolled, []` | Persisted column key order (empty = declared order); written by header drags when `allowColumnReordering` is on. `defaultColumnOrder` seeds it uncontrolled. |
| `selectedCardKey` | `unknown` | `uncontrolled, null` | The selected card's key — single selection. `defaultSelectedCardKey` seeds it uncontrolled. |
| `selectedCardKeys` | `readonly unknown[]` | `uncontrolled, []` | Every selected card key, in board order (`defaultSelectedCardKeys` seeds it uncontrolled). Ctrl/⌘-click toggles, Shift-click selects the range in the anchor's column, Ctrl+A on a card selects its column (cell), Ctrl+Space toggles, Shift+↑/↓ extends and Escape collapses to the focused card. Selected cards travel together in a drag (the ghost shows the count), Ctrl+←/→ and Delete. |
| `filterValue` | `OgeKanbanFilterExpression` | `uncontrolled, {}` | The filter chip bar's state — active `tags` / `assignees` / `priorities` (`defaultFilterValue` seeds it uncontrolled); ANDs with `filter` and the toolbar search. |
| `columnSort` | `OgeKanbanColumnSort<T>` | `uncontrolled, {}` | Per-column card sort: a column key (or `'*'`) mapped to `{ field: 'order' \| 'title' \| 'priority' \| 'dueDate', direction? }` or a comparator (`defaultColumnSort` seeds it uncontrolled). The column menu writes it through `onColumnSortChange`; a drop into a sorted column lands where the sort puts it. |
| `onSelectedCardKeysChange / onFilterValueChange / onColumnSortChange` | `(value) => void` | `—` | The controlled halves of the three G3b state props — Angular's `[(…)]` models are both halves at once. |
| `onCollapsedColumnsChange / onCollapsedSwimlanesChange / onColumnOrderChange / onSelectedCardKeyChange` | `(value) => void` | `—` | The controlled halves of the four state props — Angular's `[(…)]` models are both halves at once. |

_Filtering, selection & transfers_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | `OgeKanbanFilter<T> \| undefined` | `undefined` | Programmatic card filter: a predicate over the normalized card, or an `OgeKanbanFilterExpression` (`{ tags?, assignees?, priorities?, columns?, swimlanes?, text?, overdue? }` — values inside a field are alternatives, fields combine with AND). Filters only what is shown: WIP counts, exports (unless `visibleOnly`) and the chips stay on the full data. |
| `showFilterBar` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the filter chip bar under the toolbar: one toggle chip (`aria-pressed`) per distinct tag, assignee and priority, plus a reset button. |
| `priorityOrder` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Priority ranking for `columnSort` by priority, most important first (case-insensitive). Unset: `urgent, critical, highest, high, medium, normal, low, lowest`; numeric priorities compare as numbers. |
| `selectionMode` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'multiple'` | `'multiple'` adds Ctrl/Shift-click, the selection shortcuts and multi-card drag; `'single'` keeps one selected card. |
| `dragGroup / boardId` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Boards sharing a `dragGroup` exchange cards: drag a card (or a selection) onto the other board, or use the card menu's “Move to …” entries — the keyboard and single-pointer twin. `boardId` names the board in the transfer callbacks and the other boards' menus (a generated id otherwise). |
| `swimlaneWipLimits` | `Readonly<Record<string, number>> \| undefined` | `undefined` | Per-lane total WIP limits keyed by swimlane value — the lane header's count turns danger when exceeded. Per-cell limits are `OgeKanbanColumn.swimlaneWipLimit` (the column inside each lane). |
| `checklistExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `undefined` | Checklist / sub-task field: an array of `{ text, done }` (`title` / `checked` / `completed` and plain strings are read too). Cards show a progress badge with an ICU-plural screen-reader text; `toggleChecklistItem()` writes back in the entry's own shape. |
| `quickAdd / inlineTitleEditing` | `boolean` | `false / false` | `quickAdd`: the column footer's add button opens an inline title composer (Enter adds and keeps it open, Escape closes) instead of the dialog. `inlineTitleEditing`: double-clicking a card title edits it in place; F2 on a card always does (both through `onCardAdding` / `onCardUpdating`). |
| `undoLimit` | `number` | `50` | Undo/redo depth — Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y (or Ctrl+Shift+Z) and the toolbar buttons. Undo replays the inverse through the cancelable pipelines, so the `-ing` / `-ed` events fire as for the original edit; a multi-card move or bulk delete is one step. Cross-board transfers are not recorded (they span two boards). `0` disables history and hides the buttons. |

_Behavior_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `virtualScrolling` | `boolean` | `true` | Per-column card windowing over a fixed `cardHeight` — 10k cards stay smooth. Rich variable-height render props may opt out (`false`), the documented exception. |
| `cardHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `undefined (config: 112)` | Fixed card height in px; also drives the drag hit-testing and the keyboard scroll-into-view math. |
| `showToolbar` | `boolean` | `true` | The built-in toolbar: primary add button, collapse/expand-all pill and the search box. |
| `allowAdding / allowUpdating / allowDeleting / allowDragging / allowColumnReordering / allowColumnAdding` | `boolean` | `true / true / true / true / false / false` | Capability gates for the toolbar, dialog, menu, hover quick actions, keyboard shortcuts and drags. `allowColumnAdding` renders the "+ Add column" ghost column (inline composer → cancelable `onColumnAdding` → `onColumnAdded`). Per-column `allowAdding: false` overrides the board. |
| `columnWidth` | `number` | `300` | Fixed column track width in px — headers stay legible and the board scrolls horizontally, Trello-style. |
| `cardColorMode` | `'stripe' \| 'surface'` | `'stripe'` | How `colorExpr` renders: an accent bar on the card's edge, or the whole card surface tinted with the color. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Right-to-left layout: the first column sits on the right, ArrowLeft/Right roving and Ctrl+Arrow card moves are mirrored (ArrowLeft goes to the next column), the column-reorder drag and drop hit-testing follow the mirrored geometry and the collapsed-lane chevron points left. Unset follows the page — the computed `direction` or the nearest `dir` attribute, read after the first render and kept current when a `dir` changes; an explicit value also sets `dir` on the host. |
| `dialogItems` | `readonly OgeFormItemDefinition[] \| undefined` | `undefined` | Replaces the edit dialog's default form wholesale (`<OgeForm>` items from `@oge-ui/react-forms`); `onCardEditDialogShowing` can still adjust per open. The default form only renders editors for fields the board actually maps. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | One switch over every `allow*` capability; the context menu falls back to the browser's native menu. |
| `messages / locale` | `Partial<OgeKanbanMessages> / string \| undefined` | `{} / undefined` | Per-instance overrides of the context config (`<OgeKanbanConfigProvider>`). Every user-facing string, aria labels and live-region templates included, lives in the messages interface; `locale` drives every Intl format. |

_Render props_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderCard` | `(context: OgeKanbanCardRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | Replaces the card body (`{ card, column, swimlane }`, the card with its `source`). Drag, keyboard and ARIA stay on the board — the React face of `*ogeKanbanCardTemplate`. Buttons, links and inputs it renders are real interactive content: Tab reaches them while the card is its column's tab stop, they never start a drag or feed the board's arrow keys, and Escape returns to the card. |
| `renderColumnHeader` | `(context: OgeKanbanColumnHeaderRenderContext) => ReactNode` | Replaces the column header's title row (`{ column, count, wip }`); the add and collapse affordances stay — the React face of `*ogeKanbanColumnHeaderTemplate`. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | Host styling, merged onto the `.oge-kanban` element (give the board a height, as with the Angular host). |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addCard(item)` | `(item: T) => void` | Programmatic insert through the cancelable `onCardAdding` pipeline; the column and swimlane resolve from the item's own fields. |
| `updateCard(original, updated)` | `(original: T, updated: T) => void` | Programmatic update through the cancelable `onCardUpdating` pipeline. |
| `deleteCard(item)` | `(item: T) => void` | Programmatic delete through the cancelable `onCardDeleting` pipeline. |
| `moveCard(key, toColumn, toIndex?, toSwimlane?)` | `(key: unknown, toColumn: string, toIndex?: number, toSwimlane?: string \| null) => void` | Moves a card (append when `toIndex` is omitted) through the cancelable `onCardMoving` pipeline — the same path the drag, the Ctrl+Arrow twin and the context menu commit through. |
| `editCard(card) / openNewCard(column, swimlane)` | `(…) => void` | Opens the built-in dialog for an existing card / prefilled for a new card, through the `onCardEditDialogShowing` hook. |
| `closeDialog()` | `() => void` | Closes the edit dialog without saving; fires `onCardEditDialogHidden`. |
| `collapseAllColumns() / expandAllColumns()` | `() => void` | The toolbar buttons, callable from code. |
| `undo() / redo() / canUndo() / canRedo()` | `() => void / () => boolean` | History: revert / re-apply the last step through the cancelable pipelines, and whether a step exists. |
| `selectCards(keys) / clearSelection()` | `(keys: readonly unknown[]) => void / () => void` | Programmatic selection (board order applied; writes `selectedCardKeys` / `onSelectedCardKeysChange`). |
| `moveCards(keys, toColumn, toIndex?, toSwimlane?)` | `(keys: readonly unknown[], toColumn: string, toIndex?: number, toSwimlane?: string \| null) => void` | Moves several cards into one cell as one undoable step, inserted consecutively (board order kept) before the card at `toIndex`; without `toSwimlane` every card stays in its own lane. Each card runs `onCardMoving` / `onCardMoved`. |
| `deleteCards(items)` | `(items: readonly T[]) => void` | Bulk delete as one undoable step, each item through `onCardDeleting`; announced with an ICU plural. |
| `transferCards(keys, toBoard, toColumn?, toIndex?, toSwimlane?)` | `(…) => boolean` | Sends cards to another mounted board of the same `dragGroup` (default: its first droppable column, appended). Returns whether the target's `onCardTransferring` accepted them. |
| `toggleChecklistItem(key, index)` | `(key: unknown, index: number) => void` | Toggles one checklist entry through `onCardUpdating` (needs a field-name `checklistExpr`). |
| `startTitleEdit(key)` | `(key: unknown) => void` | Opens the inline title editor on a card (what F2 does); Enter or blur commits through `onCardUpdating`, Escape cancels. |
| `clearFilters()` | `() => void` | Resets the chip bar (`filterValue` / `onFilterValueChange`); the programmatic `filter` input is untouched. |
| `getExportData(options?) / exportToCsv(fileName?, options?)` | `(options?: OgeKanbanExportOptions) => OgeKanbanExportData / (fileName?: string, options?: OgeKanbanExportOptions) => string` | The cards as export rows in board order (column → lane → cell; `visibleOnly` keeps only what the filters show), and a CSV download built on core's formula-guarded `buildCsv` (returns the text). Excel is the lazy `@oge-ui/react-kanban/export-excel` entry. |

#### Events

_Callbacks_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onCardClick / onCardDblClick / onCardContextMenu` | `(event: OgeKanbanCardEvent<T>) => void` | Pointer interactions with a card (`{ card, event }`, the native `MouseEvent`). Double-click also opens the editor; right-click fires _before_ the built-in menu opens, so app handlers can coexist with it. |
| `onCardAdding / onCardUpdating / onCardDeleting / onCardMoving` | `(event: Oge…Event<T>) => void (mutable cancel)` | Cancelable pre-events — set `event.cancel = true` to veto. `onCardMoving` carries `{ card, fromColumn, toColumn, fromIndex, toIndex, fromSwimlane, toSwimlane }` and guards drags, keyboard moves and programmatic moves alike. |
| `onCardAdded / onCardUpdated / onCardDeleted / onCardMoved` | `(event: Oge…Event<T>) => void` | Past-tense callbacks fire only for applied changes and carry the data to persist (`onCardMoved`'s `card` is the _updated_ item, orderExpr write-back included). |
| `onCardEditDialogShowing` | `(event: OgeKanbanEditDialogShowingEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable + customization point before the dialog opens: `formItems` arrives pre-populated with the default `<OgeForm>` items and may be mutated or replaced (dx `onAppointmentFormOpening` parity). |
| `onCardEditDialogHidden` | `() => void` | The edit dialog closed — saved, cancelled, deleted or `closeDialog()` (Syncfusion `dialogClose` parity). |
| `onColumnReordered` | `(event: OgeKanbanColumnReorderedEvent) => void` | A header drag committed a new order: `{ column, fromIndex, toIndex, columnOrder }`. |
| `onColumnAdding / onColumnAdded` | `(event: OgeKanbanColumnAddingEvent / OgeKanbanColumnAddedEvent) => void` | The "+ Add column" composer's cancelable pre-event and its past-tense commit. |
| `onCardTransferring` | `(event: OgeKanbanCardTransferringEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable, called on the **target** board before cards from another board of the `dragGroup` land: `{ cards, fromBoard, toBoard, fromColumn, toColumn, fromSwimlane, toSwimlane, toIndex, cancel }`. |
| `onCardTransferred` | `(event: OgeKanbanCardTransferredEvent<T>) => void` | Called on **both** boards after a transfer landed: the source host removes `sourceCards` from its data, the target host adds `cards` (column / swimlane already written). |

#### Types

_Render contexts_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeKanbanCardRenderContext<T>` | `interface` | `{ card, column, swimlane }` — what `renderCard` is handed (the context of Angular's `*ogeKanbanCardTemplate`, `$implicit` named `card`). |
| `OgeKanbanColumnHeaderRenderContext` | `interface` | `{ column, count, wip }` — what `renderColumnHeader` is handed. An OGE extra — no reference library templates its headers. |

_Configuration_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeKanbanConfigProvider` | `({ config?: OgeKanbanConfigInput, children }) => JSX` | The React counterpart of `provideOgeKanbanConfig()`: `messages` (merged block by block), `locale`, `cardHeight` for the subtree. Nested providers merge over the outer one, and a new `config` re-resolves the subtree — switching the UI language at runtime is a state change. |
| `useOgeKanbanConfig` | `() => OgeKanbanConfig` | The resolved config for the current subtree (the counterpart of `inject(OGE_KANBAN_CONFIG)`). |
| `OgeKanbanMessages` | `interface` | Every user-facing string: `toolbar`, `menu`, `dialog`, `board` (aria label templates with `{title}`/`{count}`/`{limit}` tokens) and `announcements` (live-region templates). Single-sourced in `@oge-ui/kanban-engine` with the Angular package. |
| `OgeKanbanBoardMessages` | `interface` | The `board` block: `boardLabel`, `columnLabel` / `columnLabelWip` (the column list's name), `cardLabel` (`{title}`, `{column}`), `cardRoleDescription` (default `card` — every card's `aria-roledescription`), `editCardAction` / `deleteCardAction` (the quick-action buttons, `{title}`), `boardHint`, `wipExceeded`, `overdue`, the empty-state and add-card/column strings. |
| `OgeKanbanColumn` | `interface` | `{ key, title?, color?, wipLimit?, minCount?, collapsed?, allowAdding?, allowDrag?, allowDrop?, transitionColumns? }` — the declared column shape. `wipLimit`/`minCount` drive the danger/warning badges; `allowDrag`/`allowDrop`/`transitionColumns` gate interactive moves (programmatic `moveCard` is deliberately not gated). |
| `OgeKanbanCard<T>` | `interface` | The normalized card handed to render props and callbacks: `key`, `source` (your item, unchanged), `column`, `title`, `description`, `color`, `order`, `swimlane`, `tags`, `assignees`, `dueDate`, `priority`, `checklist` (`{ text, done }[]`). |

_Filtering, sorting & selection types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeKanbanFilter<T>` | `type` | `((card: OgeKanbanCard<T>) => boolean) \| OgeKanbanFilterExpression` — the `filter` input's shape. |
| `OgeKanbanFilterExpression` | `interface` | `{ tags?, assignees?, priorities?, columns?, swimlanes?, text?, overdue? }` — any-of inside a field, all-of across fields; also the chip bar's `filterValue`. |
| `OgeKanbanColumnSort<T>` | `type` | `Readonly<Record<string, OgeKanbanColumnSortSpec<T>>>` keyed by column (`'*'` = every column). |
| `OgeKanbanColumnSortSpec<T>` | `type` | `{ field: OgeKanbanSortField; direction?: 'asc' \| 'desc' }` or a card comparator (ties fall back to the board order). |
| `OgeKanbanSortField` | `'order' \| 'title' \| 'priority' \| 'dueDate'` | Sort fields; ascending priority puts the most important first, empty due dates sort last in both directions. |
| `OgeKanbanSelectionMode` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | The `selectionMode` union. |
| `OgeKanbanCardTransferringEvent<T> / OgeKanbanCardTransferredEvent<T>` | `interface` | Cross-board transfer payloads: board ids, from/to column and lane, insertion index; the past-tense one carries both `cards` (as landed) and `sourceCards`. |

_Export_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeKanbanExportData` | `interface` | `{ rows, messages, locale, hasSwimlanes }` — what `getExportData()` returns and both exporters read. |
| `OgeKanbanExportRow` | `interface` | `{ key, title, column, columnKey, swimlane, description, tags, assignees, priority, dueDate, checklistDone, checklistTotal }`. |
| `OgeKanbanExportOptions` | `interface` | `{ visibleOnly? }` — only the cards the filters and search show. |
| `OgeKanbanExportMessages` | `interface` | The optional `export` messages block: `sheetName` and every column header (English fallback when a catalog omits it). |
| `exportKanbanToExcel(board, options?)` | `(board, options?: OgeKanbanExcelExportOptions) => Promise<void>` | The lazy `/export-excel` entry (optional `exceljs` peer): one row per card, due dates as real dates, tags/assignees joined with `;`. Pass the board instance (Angular) or its ref handle (React). |
| `buildKanbanExcelWorkbook(data, options?)` | `(data: OgeKanbanExportData, options?) => Workbook` | The pure builder behind it, shared by both layers through `@oge-ui/kanban-engine/export-excel`. |
| `OgeKanbanExcelExportOptions` | `interface` | `{ filename?, sheetName?, visibleOnly? }` (defaults `kanban.xlsx` / the `export.sheetName` message). |

### Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

#### Filter chips & search

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanFilterExpression } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const columns = [
  { key: 'todo', title: 'To do' },
  { key: 'doing', title: 'In progress', wipLimit: 3 },
  { key: 'done', title: 'Done' },
];

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Checkout revamp', labels: ['feature'], owner: 'Ada Lovelace', priority: 'high' },
  { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: 'Wallet UI polish', labels: ['design'], owner: 'Grace Hopper', priority: 'medium' },
  { id: 3, status: 'doing', title: 'Fix login crash', labels: ['bug'], owner: 'Ada Lovelace', priority: 'high' },
  { id: 4, status: 'doing', title: 'Upgrade CI runners', labels: ['infra'], owner: 'Alan Turing', priority: 'low' },
  { id: 5, status: 'done', title: 'Search relevance', labels: ['feature'], owner: 'Grace Hopper', priority: 'medium' },
];

export function ChipBoard() {
  const [chips, setChips] = useState<OgeKanbanFilterExpression>({
    priorities: ['high'],
  });
  const active = [
    ...(chips.tags ?? []),
    ...(chips.assignees ?? []),
    ...(chips.priorities ?? []),
  ];
  return (
    <>
      {/* showFilterBar renders one toggle chip per distinct tag, assignee and
          priority; chips in a group are alternatives, groups combine with AND,
          and the toolbar search narrows further. filterValue +
          onFilterValueChange is the controlled chip state. WIP counts keep
          counting the real data. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        tagsExpr="labels"
        assigneeExpr="owner"
        priorityExpr="priority"
        columns={columns}
        showFilterBar
        filterValue={chips}
        onFilterValueChange={setChips}
        style={{ height: 460 }}
      />
      <p>Active chips: {active.length > 0 ? active.join(', ') : 'none'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Programmatic filter

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanFilter } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

interface Task {
  id: number;
  status: string;
  title: string;
  owner: string;
  due?: Date;
}

const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Quarterly report', owner: 'Ada Lovelace', due: new Date(2020, 0, 10) },
  { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: 'Vendor review', owner: 'Grace Hopper', due: new Date(2099, 5, 1) },
  { id: 3, status: 'doing', title: 'Hiring plan', owner: 'Ada Lovelace' },
  { id: 4, status: 'done', title: 'Offsite booking', owner: 'Alan Turing', due: new Date(2020, 3, 2) },
];

export function FilteredBoard() {
  const [onlyMine, setOnlyMine] = useState(false);
  const [onlyOverdue, setOnlyOverdue] = useState(false);
  const filter: OgeKanbanFilter<Task> | undefined = onlyOverdue
    ? { overdue: true }
    : onlyMine
      ? (card) => card.assignees.includes('Ada Lovelace')
      : undefined;
  return (
    <>
      {/* filter takes a predicate over the normalized card (its source is your
          item) or a declarative expression ({ tags, assignees, priorities,
          columns, swimlanes, text, overdue }); it ANDs with chips and search. */}
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={onlyMine} onChange={() => setOnlyMine(!onlyMine)} />
        Only my cards
      </label>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={onlyOverdue} onChange={() => setOnlyOverdue(!onlyOverdue)} />
        Only overdue
      </label>
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        assigneeExpr="owner"
        dueDateExpr="due"
        filter={filter}
        style={{ height: 400 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Column sort

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanColumnSort } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

interface Task {
  id: number;
  status: string;
  title: string;
  priority: string;
  due: Date;
}

const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Polish onboarding', priority: 'low', due: new Date(2026, 9, 20) },
  { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: 'Payment outage', priority: 'blocker', due: new Date(2026, 9, 6) },
  { id: 3, status: 'todo', title: 'Audit log export', priority: 'medium', due: new Date(2026, 9, 12) },
  { id: 4, status: 'done', title: 'Sprint 41 review', priority: 'medium', due: new Date(2026, 8, 18) },

];

export function SortedBoard() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<OgeKanbanColumnSort<Task>>({
    todo: { field: 'priority' },
    done: { field: 'dueDate', direction: 'desc' },

  return (

    </>

#### Export

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

interface Task {
  id: number;
  status: string;
  title: string;
  labels: string[];
  todo?: { text: string; done: boolean }[];
}

const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Release notes', labels: ['docs'], todo: [{ text: 'Draft', done: true }, { text: 'Review', done: false }] },
  { id: 2, status: 'doing', title: '=SUM(A1) is exported as text', labels: ['security'] },
  { id: 3, status: 'done', title: 'Changelog', labels: ['docs'] },
];

export function ExportBoard() {
  const board = useRef<OgeKanbanHandle<Task>>(null);
  const exportExcel = async () => {
    const { exportKanbanToExcel } = await import('@oge-ui/react-kanban/export-excel');
    if (board.current) await exportKanbanToExcel(board.current, { filename: 'cards.xlsx' });
  };
  return (
    <>
      {/* exportToCsv() downloads a formula-guarded CSV (core's buildCsv) in
          board order and returns the text; the lazy export-excel entry builds an
          .xlsx through the optional exceljs peer. { visibleOnly: true } exports
          only what the filters show. */}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => board.current?.exportToCsv('cards.csv')}>Export CSV</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={exportExcel}>Export Excel</button>
      <OgeKanban
        ref={board}
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        tagsExpr="labels"
        checklistExpr="todo"
        style={{ height: 360 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Multi-select & undo

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Ctrl-click me' },
  { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: '…and me' },
  { id: 3, status: 'todo', title: 'Shift-click for a range' },
  { id: 4, status: 'doing', title: 'Drag a selected card' },
  { id: 5, status: 'done', title: 'Ctrl+Z undoes the last step' },
];

export function MultiSelectBoard() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<readonly unknown[]>([]);
  return (
    <>
      {/* Ctrl/⌘-click toggles, Shift-click selects a range in the column,
          Ctrl+A on a card selects its column, Ctrl+Space toggles, Shift+↑/↓
          extends, Escape collapses. A drag of a selected card carries the

#### Cross-board drag

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanCardTransferredEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

interface Task {
  id: number;
  status: string;
  title: string;
}

export function PlanningBoards() {
  const [backlog, setBacklog] = useState<Task[]>([
    { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Dark mode' },
    { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: 'CSV import' },
    { id: 3, status: 'todo', title: 'Audit log' },
  ]);
  const [sprint, setSprint] = useState<Task[]>([
    { id: 10, status: 'todo', title: 'Login rate limits' },
  ]);
  // both boards report the transfer — idempotent updates make that harmless
  const onTransferred = (event: OgeKanbanCardTransferredEvent<Task>) => {
    const moved = new Set(event.sourceCards.map((task) => task.id));
    const [setFrom, setTo] =
      event.fromBoard === 'Backlog' ? [setBacklog, setSprint] : [setSprint, setBacklog];
    setFrom((list) => list.filter((task) => !moved.has(task.id)));
    setTo((list) => [...list.filter((task) => !moved.has(task.id)), ...event.cards]);
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 12, gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr' }}>
      {/* Boards sharing a dragGroup exchange cards by drag or the card menu's
          "Move to …" entry (the keyboard twin). The target calls the cancelable
          onCardTransferring; both boards call onCardTransferred. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={backlog}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        dragGroup="planning"
        boardId="Backlog"
        columns={[{ key: 'todo', title: 'Ideas' }]}
        onCardTransferred={onTransferred}
        style={{ height: 360 }}
      />
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={sprint}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        dragGroup="planning"
        boardId="Sprint"
        columns={[{ key: 'todo', title: 'To do' }, { key: 'doing', title: 'In progress' }]}
        onCardTransferred={onTransferred}
        style={{ height: 360 }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

    due: new Date(2026, 7, 5),
    priority: 'high',
    labels: ['bug'],
  },
  { id: 5, status: 'done', title: 'Q3 roadmap draft' },
];

export function TaskBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* One element, a working board. Any item shape binds through the
          *Expr props — field names, dotted paths or getter functions. Columns can
          be declared (with titles, colors and WIP limits) or derived from the data.
          Drag a card between columns (Escape cancels mid-drag), double-click to
          edit, right-click for the built-in menu, type in the toolbar to search,
          and add a column at the board's end (allowColumnAdding). The edit
          dialog only offers editors for fields the board maps. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        descriptionExpr="notes"
        assigneeExpr="owner"
        dueDateExpr="due"
        priorityExpr="priority"
        tagsExpr="labels"
        columns={columns}
        allowColumnAdding
        style={{ height: 520 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

#### Drag & drop pipeline

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanCardMovingEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Refactor auth', rank: 0 },
  { id: 2, status: 'todo', title: 'Ship dark mode', rank: 1 },
  { id: 3, status: 'doing', title: 'Bundle size audit', rank: 0 },
  { id: 4, status: 'done', title: 'This card is locked in', rank: 0 },
];

function onMoving(event: OgeKanbanCardMovingEvent): void {
  // veto example: nothing may leave "done"
  if (event.fromColumn === 'done') event.cancel = true;
}

export function GuardedBoard() {
  const [log, setLog] = useState('drag a card');
  return (
    <>
      {/* Every move — drag, Ctrl+Arrow or moveCard() — runs the same
          cancelable pipeline: onCardMoving (set cancel = true to veto) then
          onCardMoved with {card, fromColumn, toColumn, fromIndex, toIndex}.
          Mid-drag Escape restores everything. orderExpr persists the in-column
          order back onto your items; without it the array order is the board
          order. Column headers drag too (allowColumnReordering). */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        orderExpr="rank"
        allowColumnReordering
        onCardMoving={onMoving}
        onCardMoved={(e) => setLog(`moved: ${e.toColumn} @ ${e.toIndex}`)}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
      <p>{log}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
