#### Edit dialog & events

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanEditDialogShowingEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, status: 'todo', title: 'Double-click me', notes: 'Custom form field below' },
  { id: 2, status: 'doing', title: 'Right-click me for the menu' },
];

function onDialogShowing(event: OgeKanbanEditDialogShowingEvent): void {
  // drop the color field and add a sprint picker
  event.formItems = [
    ...event.formItems.filter((item) => item.field !== 'color'),
    {
      field: 'sprint',
      label: 'Sprint',
      editorType: 'selectBox',
      editorOptions: { items: ['Sprint 41', 'Sprint 42', 'Sprint 43'] },
    },
  ];
}

export function DialogBoard() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* The built-in dialog (an <OgeForm>) covers the standard fields;
          onCardEditDialogShowing is both the veto and the customization point —
          formItems arrives pre-populated and may be mutated or replaced. Saves
          and deletes run the cancelable onCardUpdating / onCardDeleting
          pipelines; new cards go through onCardAdding. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={tasks}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="status"
        titleExpr="title"
        descriptionExpr="notes"
        onCardEditDialogShowing={onDialogShowing}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Card template

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeKanban } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';
import type { OgeKanbanCard } from '@oge-ui/react-kanban';

const deployments = [
  { id: 1, stage: 'staging', service: 'api-gateway', version: 'v2.14.0', health: 98 },
  { id: 2, stage: 'staging', service: 'search', version: 'v1.9.2', health: 74 },
  { id: 3, stage: 'production', service: 'billing', version: 'v3.1.1', health: 100 },
];

function field(card: OgeKanbanCard, name: string): string {
  return String((card.source as Record<string, unknown>)[name] ?? '');
}

export function DeploymentBoard() {
  const [log, setLog] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      {/* renderCard replaces the card body while drag, keyboard and ARIA stay
          on the board. card.source is your original item (typed unknown —
          narrow it in a helper). Controls it renders are real interactive
          content: Tab from the card reaches the button, it never starts a
          drag, and Escape returns to the card. Rich templates usually pair
          with a matching cardHeight, or opt out of virtualization entirely
          (virtualScrolling={false}) when heights must vary. */}
      <OgeKanban
        dataSource={deployments}
        keyExpr="id"
        columnExpr="stage"
        titleExpr="service"
        cardHeight={112}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
        renderCard={({ card }) => (
          <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, flex: 1 }}>
            <strong>{card.title}</strong>
            <code style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{field(card, 'version')}</code>
            <progress value={Number(field(card, 'health'))} max={100} style={{ width: '100%' }} />
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setLog(`Rollback requested: ${card.title}`)}>
              Roll back
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      />
      <p aria-live="polite">{log}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

## @oge-ui/react-charts

React charts on a dependency-free SVG kernel: sixteen cartesian series types (line/spline/step/area/stacked/bar/range/scatter/bubble/candlestick), pie and doughnut, radar/polar, a range selector, circular and linear gauges, bullet charts, sparklines, funnel/pyramid, heatmap, treemap, sunburst, Sankey and a GeoJSON vector map — time and log axes, multiple value axes, strip lines, annotations, wheel/drag zoom and pan, crosshair, shared tooltips, an interactive legend, selection, keyboard point inspection and PNG/SVG export — running the same charts engine and stylesheet as the Angular charts package.

**This package is commercially licensed — unlike the rest of the suite, it is not MIT. See https://www.ogeui.com/license before shipping it.**

Docs: https://www.ogeui.com/components/charts

### <OgeChart>

#### Properties

_Data & series_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Data items; never mutated. |
| `series` | `readonly OgeChartSeriesInput[]` | `[]` | Series definitions: `type` (26 kinds — see `OgeChartSeriesType`), field mapping (`valueField`/`argumentField` — names, dotted paths or getters), `name`, `color`, `axis` (value-axis index), `stack` group, `dashStyle`/`width`/`opacity`, `showInLegend`, rangeArea bounds (`value1Field`/`value2Field`) and candlestick/ohlc OHLC (`openField`/`highField`/`lowField`/`closeField`), `sizeField` (bubble area), `visible` (start hidden; the legend re-shows) and `showLabels` (shorthand for `label.visible`). The per-point, label and analytics options are listed under _Series options_. Null/NaN values render as gaps. Inline arrays are fine: structurally equal props never rebuild the chart. |
| `commonSeries` | `Partial<OgeChartSeriesInput>` | `{}` | Defaults merged under every series (dx `commonSeriesSettings` parity). |
| `palette` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `—` | Series colors; defaults to the 10-color `OGE_CHART_PALETTE` (concrete hex values so exported images keep their colors). |

_Series options (OgeChartSeriesInput)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `OgeChartLabelOptions` | Data labels on any cartesian or polar series: `{ visible?, position?, format?, showForZero?, overlap? }`. `position`: `'outside'` (default; past the bar end / above the point), `'inside'`/`'insideEnd'`, `'center'`, `'insideBase'` — inside labels pick a contrasting text colour from the mark. `format(info)` returns the text (`info.text` is the SI default, `info.percent` the full-stacked/pareto share). `overlap`: `'hide'` (default) drops a label that would cover an earlier one, `'shift'` nudges it clear first, `'none'` keeps all; labels are always pulled inside the plot. Labels never change the screen-reader data table. |
| `colorField / customizePoint` | `field \| (info: OgeChartPointInfo) => OgeChartPointStyle` | Per-point colour from the data, or a hook returning `{ color?, label?: { visible?, text? }, marker?: { visible?, size? }, description? }` per point (wins over `colorField`). Bars, markers, candles, OHLC ticks, boxes and polar sectors take the colour; the legend swatch stripes the distinct colours; the tooltip marker follows the point. `description` is spoken in the tooltip, the announcement and the sr-table cell — colour is never the only channel. |
| `trendline` | `OgeTrendlineType \| OgeChartTrendlineOptions` | A regression or smoothing line over the series: `'linear' \| 'exponential' \| 'logarithmic' \| 'polynomial' \| 'movingAverage'`, or `{ type, order? (polynomial 2–6), period? (moving average), color?, width?, dashStyle? ('dash'), showR2? }`. `showR2` appends the trend value and R² to the series' tooltip row. The fit is the pure `ogeTrendline()`. |
| `indicator` | `OgeChartIndicatorOptions` | For `type: 'indicator'`: `{ type: 'sma' \| 'ema' \| 'bollinger' \| 'macd' \| 'rsi', period?, stdDev?, fastPeriod?, slowPeriod?, signalPeriod?, levels? }` computed from `valueField` (or `closeField` of OHLC data). Bollinger draws a band and two lines, MACD a signal line and a histogram, RSI reference levels at 30/70. Default names like `SMA (10)` come from `messages.values`. Put RSI/MACD into their own pane: `pane: 'rsi'` on the series plus a `panes` entry and a value axis with `pane: 'rsi'`. |
| `summaryField / upColor / downColor / totalColor / showConnectors` | `field / string / string / string / boolean` | `waterfall`: values are deltas floating from the running total; `summaryField` marks sums — `'total'` (or `true`) spans zero → running total, `'intermediate'` the subtotal since the previous intermediate sum. Rising/falling/sum bars colour `upColor` (green), `downColor` (red), `totalColor` (the series colour); dashed connectors join the bars (`showConnectors: false` drops them). The sr table and tooltip say _increase_/_decrease_/_total_. |
| `valuesField / q1Field / medianField / q3Field / outliersField / whiskers` | `field / … / 'tukey' \| 'minMax'` | `boxPlot`: from raw values (`valuesField` holding a `number[]` per category — quartiles by linear interpolation, Tukey 1.5 × IQR whiskers by default, the rest as outlier dots) or precomputed (`lowField`/`q1Field`/`medianField`/`q3Field`/`highField`, `outliersField`). The tooltip and sr table read _Min, Q1, Median, Q3, Max_. Pure: `ogeBoxStats()`. |
| `bins` | `OgeHistogramBinning` | `histogram`: bins `valueField` over the whole data source — `{ count? }` (default: Sturges' rule, rounded to a 1-2-5 width), `{ width? }` or explicit `{ thresholds? }` edges. Bars span their bins on a linear argument axis; the argument reads `start – end`. Pure: `ogeHistogramBins()`. |
| `cumulativeAxis / cumulativeColor` | `number / string` | `pareto`: categories sort by value (descending) and a cumulative-% line with dots runs over the bars. `cumulativeAxis` puts the line on a declared value axis (give it `position: 'end'`; it spans 0–100); without one the line uses an implicit 0–100% scale. The tooltip adds _cumulative 45%_. |

_Axes_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `argumentAxis` | `OgeChartAxisOptions` | `{}` | Argument axis: `type` auto-detects (numbers / dates / categories) when unset; `min`/`max`, `inverted`, `grid`, `title`; `label` (`OgeChartAxisLabelOptions`: `format` as a function or `Intl` options, `template` such as `'{value} km'`, `overlap` `rotate`/`stagger`/`hide`/`skip`/`none`, `visible`) — `labelFormat`/`labelOverlap` remain as shorthands; `tickInterval` (axis units, every n-th category, or a calendar interval such as `{ weeks: 1 }`), `minorTicks`, `strips` and `constantLines`. |
| `valueAxis` | `OgeChartAxisOptions \| readonly OgeChartAxisOptions[]` | `{}` | One or more value axes; series pick theirs via `axis` (or by `pane`). `position: 'end'` renders on the far side (right, or on top when rotated), `type: 'logarithmic'` spaces decades evenly, `abbreviate: false` disables SI labels (`1.2K`). `pane` places the axis in a pane; `constantLines` (`{ value, label?, color?, dash?, width?, position: 'inside' \| 'outside' }`) draw threshold / target lines whose labels stay clear of the plot edges; `strips` (`{ start, end, label?, color? }`) shade value bands; `breaks` (`{ start, end }[]`, linear axes) skip value ranges with a zig-zag marker; `tickInterval`, `minorTicks`, `allowDecimals: false` and `label` work as on the argument axis. |
| `stripLines` | `readonly OgeChartStripLine[]` | `[]` | Argument-axis markers: `{ start, end?, label?, color? }` — a line without `end`, a shaded band with it (see also `argumentAxis.strips` / `constantLines`). |
| `annotations` | `readonly OgeChartAnnotation[]` | `[]` | Plot annotations: `type: 'point'` draws a marker dot with a connector into a label box at (`argument`, `value`); `'text'` places the label alone (top of the plot without a value). `axis`, `color` and `offsetX/Y` refine placement. |

_Layout & direction_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rotated` | `boolean` | `false` | Swaps the axes: the argument axis runs vertically (first argument on top), the value axis horizontally. Applies to every series type — bars become horizontal bars (stacked and range bars too), lines run top-down — and the tooltip, crosshair, zoom/pan, the data table and the keyboard follow (Up/Down walk the arguments, Left/Right the series). |
| `panes` | `readonly OgeChartPane[]` | `[]` | Plot areas stacked over one shared argument axis (price + volume): `{ name, height? }` with `height` as a ratio. Series pick a pane with `pane` (binding to that pane's first value axis, or a default one) and value axes with `valueAxis[].pane`; stacks and bar slots are per pane. The argument axis sits under the last pane, the crosshair spans every pane (its horizontal line stays in the hovered one) and zoom/pan move them together. Rotated charts lay panes side by side. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Right-to-left layout: mirrors the argument axis, moves the value axes to the other side, flips the legend, the tooltip's opening side and the Left/Right arrow keys. Unset follows the page — the computed `direction` or the nearest `dir` attribute, read after the first render (re-read by `refresh()`); an explicit value also sets `dir` on the host. |

_Interaction_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `zoomEnabled / panEnabled` | `'none' \| 'wheel' \| 'drag' \| 'both' / boolean` | `'none' / false` | Cursor-centered wheel zoom (a non-passive listener, so the page does not scroll under it), drag-select zoom (Escape cancels mid-drag, 8px threshold), Shift+drag pan. Escape on the focused plot resets the zoom. On touch screens two fingers pinch-zoom and pan together (the argument values under both fingers stay under them) and one finger pans when `panEnabled` is on, otherwise drag-zooms; the plot declares `touch-action` so the page still scrolls across the argument axis. |
| `visualRange / defaultVisualRange` | `OgeChartRange \| null` | `undefined / null` | The zoom window in argument-axis units (`null` = full extent) — controlled when `visualRange` is provided (pair it with `onVisualRangeChange`), otherwise seeded by `defaultVisualRange`. Writes clamp into the data bounds. |
| `tooltip` | `OgeChartTooltipOptions` | `{}` | `{ enabled?, shared? }` — shared lists every series at the hovered argument; otherwise the value-nearest series wins. |
| `crosshair` | `OgeChartCrosshairOptions` | `{}` | `{ enabled?, horizontal? }` — the vertical tracker snaps to the nearest argument (binary search). |
| `legend` | `OgeChartLegendOptions` | `{}` | `{ visible?, position? (top/bottom/start/end), interactive? }` — real buttons with `aria-pressed`; clicking toggles the series and the axes rescale. |
| `selectionMode / selectedPoints / defaultSelectedPoints` | `'point' \| 'series' \| 'none' / readonly OgeChartPointRef[]` | `'none' / undefined / []` | Click (or Enter) selects; Ctrl adds points to the set; series mode selects the whole series. `selectedPoints` is controlled when provided (pair it with `onSelectedPointsChange`). |

_Appearance & i18n_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title / subtitle` | `string` | `''` | Headings above the plot. |
| `animation` | `boolean \| OgeChartAnimationOptions` | `true` | Hover/selection transitions plus a one-time draw-in on the first render with data — each series grows from its value baseline (bars grow, lines rise) in every orientation. `{ enabled?, duration? (ms, 600), easing? ('linear' \| 'ease' \| 'easeIn' \| 'easeOut' \| 'easeInOut') }`; `false` turns both off and `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` always does. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | BCP 47 locale for every `Intl` format; defaults to the config locale, then the browser locale. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `{}` | Per-instance message overrides, merged over the provider config per top-level block. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the `.oge-chart` host element — give it a height (`style={{ height: 380 }}`). |

#### Methods

_OgeChartHandle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `zoomToRange(range) / resetZoom()` | `void` | Programmatic zoom (clamped into the data bounds) / back to the full extent, announced. |
| `hideTooltip()` | `void` | Clears the hover state (tooltip + crosshair). |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-measures the container (ResizeObserver normally covers it). |
| `focus()` | `void` | Focuses the keyboard-inspectable plot region. |
| `getExportData()` | `OgeChartExportData<T>` | Snapshot for custom pipelines: per-series names/types/colors/visibility/points plus the plotted range. |
| `getSvgElement()` | `SVGSVGElement` | The live SVG root — what the image exporters serialize. |
| `print(options?)` | `Promise<void>` | Opens the browser print dialog for the chart alone: the serialized SVG (computed styles inlined) in a hidden frame with a print stylesheet — the title above it, the chart scaled to the page, `@page` orientation from its aspect. `OgeChartPrintOptions`: `{ title?, orientation?, background? }`. Dependency-free. |

_Export entry points (lazy)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exportChartToPng / exportChartToJpeg / exportChartToSvg / serializeChartSvg / rasterizeChartSvg` | `@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image` | No third-party libraries: the live SVG is cloned with computed styles inlined, then downloaded as a standalone `.svg`, or rasterized onto a canvas (`pixelRatio`, `background`) for `.png` or `.jpeg` (`quality`, default 0.92 — JPEG has no alpha, so the background fills first). `rasterizeChartSvg(svg, options)` returns that canvas for custom pipelines. Import the entry point dynamically. |
| `exportChartToPdf / buildChartPdfDocument / chartPdfLayout` | `@oge-ui/react-charts/export-pdf` | A one-page PDF: the chart rasterized like the PNG export and embedded into a jsPDF page (`orientation` from the aspect, `pageFormat` `a4`, `margin` 12 mm) under an optional `title`/`subtitle` drawn as real PDF text with `font` — or the font registered via `setOgePdfDefaultFont()` from `@oge-ui/behavior` (Turkish, Greek, Cyrillic need a Unicode font). `jspdf` is an optional peer pulled in only by this entry; `buildChartPdfDocument` returns the `jsPDF` document, `chartPdfLayout` the pure page geometry. |

_Analytics (pure functions)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ogeSma / ogeEma / ogeBollingerBands / ogeMacd / ogeRsi` | `(values, period, …) => aligned arrays` | The technical indicators the `indicator` series runs, for your own pipelines: `ogeSma(values, period)`, `ogeEma(values, period)` (seeded with the first SMA), `ogeBollingerBands(values, period = 20, stdDev = 2)` → `{ middle, upper, lower }[]`, `ogeMacd(values, 12, 26, 9)` → `{ macd, signal, histogram }[]`, `ogeRsi(values, 14)` (Wilder). Input: numbers or `{ value }` objects; output aligned with the input, `null` until the window fills. |
| `ogeTrendline` | `(points, type, options?) => OgeTrendlineFit \| null` | Least-squares fits over `{ x, y }` points: `'linear'`, `'exponential'` (y > 0), `'logarithmic'` (x > 0), `'polynomial'` (`order` 2–6, x normalized so epoch-ms arguments stay well-conditioned) and `'movingAverage'` (`period`). Returns `{ coefficients, r2, predict(x), points }`. |
| `ogeBoxStats / ogeHistogramBins` | `(values, …) => OgeBoxStats \| OgeHistogramBin[]` | `ogeBoxStats(values, 'tukey' \| 'minMax')` → `{ low, q1, median, q3, high, mean, outliers }`; `ogeHistogramBins(values, { count?, width?, thresholds? })` → `{ start, end, count, indexes }[]` (the last edge inclusive). |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeChartSeriesType` | `string union` | 'line' \| 'spline' \| 'stepLine' \| 'area' \| 'splineArea' \| 'stepArea' \| 'stackedArea' \| 'fullStackedArea' \| 'stackedLine' \| 'fullStackedLine' \| 'stackedSplineArea' \| 'fullStackedSplineArea' \| 'bar' \| 'stackedBar' \| 'fullStackedBar' \| 'rangeBar' \| 'waterfall' \| 'pareto' \| 'histogram' \| 'boxPlot' \| 'scatter' \| 'bubble' \| 'rangeArea' \| 'candlestick' \| 'ohlc' \| 'indicator' — plus `'radialBar'` on the polar chart. |
| `OgeChartPoint<T>` | `interface` | The normalized point: `argument`, `argNumeric`, `value`(s incl. OHLC), `source`, `index`, plus `style` (per-point overrides), `extra` (`OgeChartPointExtra`: box quartiles, histogram `binStart`/`binEnd`, pareto `cumulative`, indicator `upper`/`lower`/`signal`/`histogram`, waterfall `total`), `outliers` and the waterfall `kind` (`'up' \| 'down' \| 'intermediate' \| 'total'`). |
| `OgeChartLabelOptions / OgeChartLabelInfo / OgeChartPointStyle / OgeChartPointInfo` | `interfaces` | The `label` options, what `label.format` receives (`{ seriesIndex, seriesName, pointIndex, argument, value, percent, source, text }`), what `customizePoint` returns and receives. |
| `OgeChartAxisType / OgeChartRange` | `'linear' \| 'logarithmic' \| 'category' \| 'time' / { min, max }` | Axis kinds and the numeric window type (time axes: epoch ms; category: index space). |
| `OgeChartConstantLine / OgeChartAxisStrip / OgeChartAxisBreak` | `interface` | Guides of an axis: `{ value, label?, color?, dash? ('solid' \| 'dash' \| 'dot'), width?, position? ('inside' \| 'outside') }`, `{ start, end, label?, color? }` and `{ start, end }` (value axes only). Colours take any CSS colour, theme tokens included. |
| `OgeChartPane` | `interface` | `{ name, height? }` — a pane of `panes`; `height` is a ratio against the other panes (default 1). |
| `OgeChartTickInterval / OgeChartDateInterval / OgeChartMinorTickOptions` | `number \| interface` | `tickInterval`: a number in axis units (ms on time axes, every n-th category on category axes) or a calendar interval `{ years?, months?, weeks?, days?, hours?, minutes? }` stepping real calendar boundaries; `minorTicks`: `true` or `{ visible?, count? (4) }`. |
| `OgeChartAxisLabelOptions / OgeChartLabelFormat / OgeChartLabelOverlap` | `interface / union` | `{ visible?, format?, template?, overlap? }`; `format` is a function or `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` / `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions`; `overlap` is `'rotate' \| 'stagger' \| 'hide' \| 'skip' \| 'none'` — decided on measured label boxes (the chart measures each label in its own svg; a character estimate before the first render). On a rotated chart's vertical argument axis the boxes are measured by their height: a label wider than the side band wraps (up to three lines, the last ellipsized, centred on its tick), `hide` / `skip` compare the real line boxes, `stagger` alternates two columns and `rotate` falls back to `skip`. |
| `OgeChartAnimationOptions / OgeChartAnimationEasing` | `interface / union` | `{ enabled?, duration?, easing? }` with `'linear' \| 'ease' \| 'easeIn' \| 'easeOut' \| 'easeInOut'`. |
| `OgeChartPeriod / OgeChartCustomPeriod` | `union / interface` | Range-selector periods: `'1M' \| '3M' \| '6M' \| 'YTD' \| '1Y' \| 'All'`, or `{ label, range }` where `range` is a window `{ min, max }`, a span in axis units back from the data end, or a calendar interval back from it. |
| `OgeChartHandle<T>` | `ref handle` | Every method above: `zoomToRange`, `resetZoom`, `hideTooltip`, `refresh`, `focus`, `getExportData`, `getSvgElement`, `print`. |

### <OgeSparkline>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly (T \| number \| null)[]` | `[]` | Plain numbers or items; `null` is a gap. |
| `valueField / argumentField` | `string \| getter / string \| getter \| undefined` | `'value' / undefined` | Field mapping for items (names, dotted paths or getters); the argument only feeds the tooltip (default the 1-based position). |
| `type` | `OgeSparklineType` | `'line'` | `'line'`, `'area'`, `'bar'` (bars from zero, negatives in `negativeColor`) or `'winloss'` (equal-height ticks above / below the middle, flat for a draw). |
| `markers` | `boolean \| OgeSparklineMarkers` | `false` | Dots on the `first` / `last` / `min` / `max` points (`true` = all four; max in the success colour, min in danger). |
| `winlossThreshold` | `number` | `0` | Win-loss: above wins, below loses, equal draws. |
| `minValue / maxValue` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | A fixed value range, so sparklines of one column compare; default the data range (bars always include 0). |
| `color / negativeColor` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Series / positive colour (default the accent) and negative bars / losses (default danger). |
| `lineWidth` | `number` | `1.5` | Line stroke width, px. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeChartsConfigProvider` | `component ({ config?: OgeChartsConfigInput })` | `—` | Configures every chart below the provider — the React counterpart of `provideOgeChartsConfig()`. Shallow merge over the outer provider (or `OGE_DEFAULT_CHARTS_CONFIG`) per top-level key — a partial `messages` replaces whole nested blocks — and it re-resolves whenever `config` changes, which is how the UI language switches at runtime. |
| `useOgeChartsConfig()` | `OgeChartsConfig` | `—` | The resolved config of the current subtree. |
| `messages` | `OgeChartsMessages` | `—` | Every user-facing string, aria labels included: `aria` (`OgeChartsAriaMessages` — chart/pie labels with `{title}`/`{count}`, table caption, plot hint, legend label), `announcements` (`OgeChartsAnnouncementMessages` — live-region templates with `{series}`/`{argument}`/`{value}`), `values` (`OgeChartsValueMessages` — the words of analytic value texts: box-plot `low`/`q1`/`median`/`q3`/`high`/`outliers`, waterfall `increase`/`decrease`/`intermediate`/`total`, pareto `cumulative`, `upper`/`lower`/`signal`/`histogram`, the trendline suffix `trend` with `{value}`/`{r2}`, the histogram `bin` and the default indicator names `sma`/`ema`/`bollinger`/`macd`/`rsi`), `periods` (`OgeChartsPeriodMessages` — the range-selector period group label, button texts and their spelled-out descriptions) `visuals` (`OgeChartsVisualMessages` — the accessible names, keyboard hints, table headers, value words and announcements of the gauges, the bullet chart, the sparkline, the funnel, heatmap, treemap, sunburst, Sankey and map; count-bearing names are ICU plurals) and `noData`. Defaults: `OGE_DEFAULT_CHARTS_MESSAGES`. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | BCP 47 locale for every `Intl` format in scope; a per-instance `locale` prop wins. |
| `a11yTableLimit` | `number` | `50` | Rows of the screen-reader data table. |
| `markerThreshold` | `number` | `200` | Marker circles render only up to this many points per series — beyond it the single path carries the series alone. Line-family paths additionally auto-downsample with LTTB to about one point per pixel once a series outgrows the plot width (hit-testing and tooltips keep the full data). |

### Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

#### Data labels

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart, OgePieChart, OgePolarChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartLabelOptions, OgeChartSeriesInput, OgePieSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

interface SalesRow {
  region: string;
  sales: number;
  target: number;
}

interface ChannelRow {
  channel: string;
  y2025: number;
  y2026: number;
}

const sales: SalesRow[] = [
  { region: 'North', sales: 182, target: 160 },
  { region: 'South', sales: 96, target: 140 },
  { region: 'East', sales: 151, target: 150 },
  { region: 'West', sales: 128, target: 130 },
  { region: 'Central', sales: 204, target: 170 },
];

const salesSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput<SalesRow>[] = [
  {
    type: 'bar',
    argumentField: 'region',
    valueField: 'sales',
    name: 'Sales',
    label: { visible: true, position: 'insideEnd' },
    customizePoint: (info) =>
      info.source !== undefined && info.source.sales < info.source.target
        ? { color: '#ef4444', description: 'below target' }
        : undefined,
  },
];

const channels: ChannelRow[] = [
  { channel: 'Online', y2025: 42, y2026: 55 },
  { channel: 'Retail', y2025: 38, y2026: 30 },
  { channel: 'Partners', y2025: 20, y2026: 15 },
];

const rings: OgePieSeriesInput<ChannelRow>[] = [
  { name: '2025', valueField: 'y2025' },
  { name: '2026', valueField: 'y2026' },
];

const percentLabels: OgeChartLabelOptions<ChannelRow> = {
  visible: true,
  position: 'inside',
  format: (info) => `${Math.round((info.percent ?? 0) * 100)}%`,
};

const goals = [
  { team: 'Design', done: 72 },
  { team: 'Web', done: 88 },
  { team: 'Mobile', done: 54 },
  { team: 'QA', done: 93 },
];

const goalSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'radialBar',
    argumentField: 'team',
    valueField: 'done',
    name: 'Done',
    label: { visible: true, format: (info) => `${info.value}%` },
  },
];

export function DataLabels() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Data labels on any series: position (outside / inside / center /
          insideEnd / insideBase), format, showForZero and overlap resolution
          (hide / shift / none). customizePoint colours single points — and its
          description is spoken in the tooltip and the screen-reader table, so
          colour is never the only channel. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={sales}
        series={salesSeries}
        title="Sales vs target (k€)"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        {/* Nested doughnut: one ring per series entry; slices of one argument
            share a colour and a legend button across rings. */}
        <OgePieChart
          dataSource={channels}
          argumentField="channel"
          type="doughnut"
          innerRadius={0.35}
          series={rings}
          label={percentLabels}
          title="Revenue by channel, 2025 → 2026"
          style={{ height: 320 }}
        />
        {/* Radial bars: one ring per category, the arc is the value. */}
        <OgePolarChart
          dataSource={goals}
          series={goalSeries}
          valueAxis={{ max: 100 }}
          title="Sprint goals done"
          style={{ height: 320 }}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Trendlines & indicators

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartAxisOptions, OgeChartPane, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const panes: OgeChartPane[] = [
  { name: 'price', height: 3 },
  { name: 'rsi', height: 1 },
];

const paneAxes: OgeChartAxisOptions[] = [
  { pane: 'price', title: 'Price' },
  { pane: 'rsi', title: 'RSI', min: 0, max: 100 },
];

const prices = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => {
  const base = 100 + Math.sin(i / 6) * 8 + i * 0.4;
  return {
    day: new Date(2026, 0, 1 + i),
    open: base - 1,
    high: base + 2.5,
    low: base - 3,
    close: base + Math.sin(i) * 1.5,
  };
});

const priceSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'ohlc',
    argumentField: 'day',
    openField: 'open',
    highField: 'high',
    lowField: 'low',
    closeField: 'close',
    name: 'OGE',
  },
  {
    type: 'indicator',
    argumentField: 'day',
    closeField: 'close',
    indicator: { type: 'bollinger', period: 20, stdDev: 2 },
  },
  {
    type: 'indicator',
    argumentField: 'day',
    closeField: 'close',
    indicator: { type: 'ema', period: 10 },
    dashStyle: 'dash',
  },
  {
    type: 'indicator',
    argumentField: 'day',
    closeField: 'close',
    indicator: { type: 'rsi', period: 14 },
    pane: 'rsi',
  },
];

const campaigns = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({
  spend: 5 + i * 2,
  revenue: 20 + (5 + i * 2) * 3.1 + Math.sin(i * 1.7) * 9,
}));

const campaignSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'scatter',
    argumentField: 'spend',
    valueField: 'revenue',
    name: 'Campaigns',
    trendline: { type: 'linear', showR2: true },
  },
];

export function Indicators() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Technical indicators are series: type 'indicator' computes SMA, EMA,
          Bollinger Bands, MACD or RSI from the close prices (the same pure
          ogeSma/ogeEma/ogeBollingerBands/ogeMacd/ogeRsi you can import). The
          RSI draws in its own pane under the price, sharing the argument axis. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={prices}
        series={priceSeries}
        panes={panes}
        valueAxis={paneAxes}
        zoomEnabled="wheel"
        tooltip={{ shared: true }}
        style={{ height: 440 }}
      />
      {/* Trendlines: linear, exponential, logarithmic, polynomial or moving
          average over any series; showR2 adds the fit to the tooltip. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={campaigns}
        series={campaignSeries}
        argumentAxis={{ title: 'Ad spend (k€)' }}
        valueAxis={{ title: 'Revenue (k€)' }}
        style={{ height: 300 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Waterfall & Pareto

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartAxisOptions, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const cashFlow = [
  { step: 'Opening', amount: 120 },
  { step: 'Sales', amount: 85 },
  { step: 'Services', amount: 34 },
  { step: 'Payroll', amount: -72 },
  { step: 'Rent', amount: -18 },
  { step: 'Q1', sum: 'intermediate' },
  { step: 'Tax', amount: -26 },
  { step: 'Closing', sum: 'total' },
];

const cashSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'waterfall',
    argumentField: 'step',
    valueField: 'amount',
    summaryField: 'sum',
    name: 'Cash flow',
    label: { visible: true },
  },
];

const defects = [
  { cause: 'Dents', count: 8 },
  { cause: 'Scratches', count: 46 },
  { cause: 'Wrong part', count: 12 },
  { cause: 'Misalignment', count: 31 },
  { cause: 'Other', count: 5 },
];

const defectSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'pareto',
    argumentField: 'cause',
    valueField: 'count',
    name: 'Defects',
    cumulativeAxis: 1,
  },
];

const paretoAxes: OgeChartAxisOptions[] = [
  { title: 'Count' },
  {
    position: 'end',
    title: 'Cumulative',
    max: 100,
    labelFormat: (value) => `${String(value)}%`,
  },
];

export function WaterfallPareto() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* waterfall: deltas float from the running total; summaryField marks
          'intermediate' subtotals and the 'total'. Rising, falling and sum bars
          colour by kind, dashed connectors join them, and the screen-reader
          table says "increase" / "decrease" / "total". */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={cashFlow}
        series={cashSeries}
        legend={{ visible: false }}
        title="Cash flow (k€)"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
      {/* pareto: bars sort by value and a cumulative-% line runs over them on
          a second value axis. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={defects}
        series={defectSeries}
        valueAxis={paretoAxes}
        title="Defects by cause"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Box plot & histogram

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const latency = ['API', 'Web', 'Worker', 'DB'].map((service, s) => ({
  service,
  samples: Array.from(
    { length: 40 },
    (_, i) => 20 + s * 12 + ((i * 37) % 29) + (i % 13 === 0 ? 55 : 0),
  ),
}));

const latencySeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'boxPlot', argumentField: 'service', valuesField: 'samples', name: 'Latency' },
];

/** Deterministic pseudo-random 0..1 (the demo needs stable data). */
const noise = (k: number): number =>
  Math.abs(Math.sin(k * 12.9898) * 43758.5453) % 1;

const heights = Array.from({ length: 240 }, (_, i) => ({
  height: 150 + 20 * (noise(i) + noise(i + 1000) + noise(i + 2000)),
}));

const heightSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'histogram',
    valueField: 'height',
    name: 'People',
    bins: { width: 5 },
    label: { visible: true },
  },
];

export function Distributions() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* boxPlot from raw samples: quartiles, Tukey whiskers (1.5 × IQR) and
          outlier dots — or from precomputed q1/median/q3 fields. The tooltip
          and the screen-reader table read Min, Q1, Median, Q3, Max. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={latency}
        series={latencySeries}
        valueAxis={{ title: 'ms' }}
        title="Response time by service"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
      {/* histogram: bins the values (count, width or explicit thresholds);
          bars span their bins and the argument reads "165 – 170". */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={heights}
        series={heightSeries}
        argumentAxis={{ title: 'Height (cm)' }}
        title="Height distribution"
        style={{ height: 300 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Export & print

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartHandle, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const energy = [
  { month: 'Jan', solar: 12, wind: 30, hydro: 18 },
  { month: 'Feb', solar: 16, wind: 27, hydro: 17 },
  { month: 'Mar', solar: 24, wind: 25, hydro: 20 },
  { month: 'Apr', solar: 31, wind: 22, hydro: 22 },
  { month: 'May', solar: 38, wind: 18, hydro: 24 },
  { month: 'Jun', solar: 42, wind: 16, hydro: 21 },
];

const energySeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'stackedSplineArea', argumentField: 'month', valueField: 'solar', name: 'Solar' },
  { type: 'stackedSplineArea', argumentField: 'month', valueField: 'wind', name: 'Wind' },
  { type: 'stackedSplineArea', argumentField: 'month', valueField: 'hydro', name: 'Hydro' },
];

export function EnergyExport() {
  const chart = useRef<OgeChartHandle>(null);

  const exportPng = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToPng } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image');
    if (chart.current) await exportChartToPng(chart.current, { filename: 'energy.png' });
  };
  const exportJpeg = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToJpeg } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image');
    if (chart.current) {
      await exportChartToJpeg(chart.current, { filename: 'energy.jpeg', quality: 0.9 });
    }
  };
  // Non-WinAnsi titles (Turkish ğ ş ı İ, Greek, Cyrillic) need a Unicode font:
  // pass `font`, or register one once with setOgePdfDefaultFont() from
  // @oge-ui/behavior — every OGE PDF export then uses it.
  const exportPdf = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToPdf } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-pdf');
    if (chart.current) {
      await exportChartToPdf(chart.current, {
        filename: 'energy.pdf',
        title: 'Energy mix',
        subtitle: 'Generation by source, GWh',
      });
    }
  };
  return (
    <>
      {/* Export without a chart library: PNG/JPEG rasterize the live SVG
          (styles inlined), PDF embeds that image under a real-text title in a
          jsPDF page (an optional peer, loaded only by /export-pdf), and print()
          opens the browser dialog for the chart alone. */}
      <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportPng()}>PNG</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportJpeg()}>JPEG</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportPdf()}>PDF</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void chart.current?.print()}>Print</button>
      </div>
      <OgeChart
        ref={chart}
        dataSource={energy}
        series={energySeries}
        title="Energy mix (GWh)"
        style={{ height: 340 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts
const data = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'].map(

export function ConstantLines() {
```

#### Panes (price + volume)

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChart, OgeRangeSelector } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartAxisOptions, OgeChartPane, OgeChartPeriod, OgeChartRange, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const data = Array.from({ length: 260 }, (_, i) => {
  const open = 100 + Math.sin(i / 14) * 18 + i * 0.12;
  const close = open + Math.sin(i * 1.7) * 3;
  return {
    day: new Date(2025, 8, 1 + i),
    open,
    close,
    high: Math.max(open, close) + 2,
    low: Math.min(open, close) - 2,
    volume: 1800 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.cos(i / 3)) * 2400),
  };
});

const panes: OgeChartPane[] = [
  { name: 'price', height: 3 },
  { name: 'volume', height: 1 },
];

const valueAxes: OgeChartAxisOptions[] = [
  { pane: 'price', title: 'Price' },
  { pane: 'volume', title: 'Volume' },
];

const series: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'candlestick',
    argumentField: 'day',
    openField: 'open',
    highField: 'high',
    lowField: 'low',
    closeField: 'close',
    name: 'OGE',
    pane: 'price',
  },
  { type: 'bar', argumentField: 'day', valueField: 'volume', name: 'Volume', pane: 'volume', opacity: 0.6 },
];

const navigator: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'area', argumentField: 'day', valueField: 'close', name: 'Close' },
];

const periods: OgeChartPeriod[] = ['1M', '3M', '6M', 'YTD', '1Y', 'All'];

export function PriceAndVolume() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<OgeChartRange | null>(null);
  return (
    // panes stack plot areas over ONE shared argument axis: series and value
    // axes pick theirs by name. The crosshair runs through every pane (its
    // horizontal line stays in the hovered one) and zoom/pan move all of them.
    // The range selector's period buttons set the same window.
    <>
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={data}
        series={series}
        panes={panes}
        valueAxis={valueAxes}
        crosshair={{ horizontal: true }}
        tooltip={{ shared: true }}
        visualRange={range}
        onVisualRangeChange={setRange}
        zoomEnabled="both"
        panEnabled
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
      <OgeRangeSelector
        dataSource={data}
        series={navigator}
        periods={periods}
        value={range}
        onValueChange={setRange}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### RTL & touch

```ts

const data = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({
```

#### Draw-in animation

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartAnimationOptions, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const data = [
  { quarter: 'Q1', revenue: 120, cost: 80 },
  { quarter: 'Q2', revenue: 150, cost: 92 },
  { quarter: 'Q3', revenue: 138, cost: 101 },
  { quarter: 'Q4', revenue: 190, cost: 110 },
];

const series: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'bar', argumentField: 'quarter', valueField: 'revenue', name: 'Revenue' },
  { type: 'spline', argumentField: 'quarter', valueField: 'cost', name: 'Cost' },
];

const animation: OgeChartAnimationOptions = { duration: 1100, easing: 'easeInOut' };

export function DrawIn() {
  // a new key re-mounts the chart, which plays the draw-in again
  const [run, setRun] = useState(0);
  return (
    // The first render draws each series in from its value baseline: bars
    // grow, lines rise. animation takes true / false or { enabled, duration,
    // easing }; prefers-reduced-motion always switches it off.
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setRun(run + 1)}>
        Replay
      </button>
      <OgeChart
        key={run}
        dataSource={data}
        series={series}
        animation={animation}
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const data = [
  'Enterprise support renewals (annual)',
  'Cloud storage',
  'Professional services and onboarding',
  'Mobile',
  'Hardware leasing',
  'Training and certification programmes',
  'Analytics add-on',
  'Marketplace commissions from partners',
  'Consulting',
  'Premium SLA upgrades for regulated industries',
  'API usage',
  'Desktop licences',
  'Security audits',
  'Data migration packages',
  'Custom integrations',
  'Community edition sponsorships',
  'Managed backups',
  'Developer seats',
].map((product, i) => ({ product, revenue: 40 + ((i * 37) % 90) }));

  { type: 'bar', argumentField: 'product', valueField: 'revenue', name: 'Revenue (k€)' },
];

const argumentAxis: OgeChartAxisOptions = { label: { overlap: 'hide' } };

export function RotatedLabels() {
  return (
    // Down a vertical axis, labels collide by their height. The chart
    // measures every label in its own svg: a name wider than the side band
    // wraps (up to three lines, centred on its bar) and label.overlap then
    // works on the real boxes — 'hide' keeps the labels that clear each other,
    // 'skip' thins by the tallest one, 'stagger' alternates two columns.
    <OgeChart
      dataSource={data}
      series={series}
      rotated
      argumentAxis={argumentAxis}
      style={{ height: 320 }}
    />
  );
}
```

#### Circular gauge

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeCircularGauge } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartValueRange } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const speedRanges: OgeChartValueRange[] = [
  { start: 0, end: 90, label: 'Normal' },
  { start: 90, end: 120, label: 'Fast' },
  { start: 120, end: 160, label: 'Over the limit' },
];

const cpuRanges: OgeChartValueRange[] = [
  { start: 0, end: 70, color: 'var(--oge-success)', label: 'Healthy' },
  { start: 70, end: 90, color: 'var(--oge-warning)', label: 'Busy' },
  { start: 90, end: 100, color: 'var(--oge-danger)', label: 'Saturated' },
];

const kmh = (value: number) => `${Math.round(value)} km/h`;
const percent = (value: number) => `${Math.round(value)}%`;

export function CircularGauges() {
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(96);
  const [cpu, setCpu] = useState(64);
  const randomize = () => {
    setSpeed(Math.round(Math.random() * 160));
    setCpu(Math.round(Math.random() * 100));
  };
  return (
    // A role="meter" dial: the value and the labelled range it falls in are
    // spoken (aria-valuetext); the indicator sweeps in and glides on change —
    // never under prefers-reduced-motion.
    <>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 12 }}>
        <OgeCircularGauge
          value={speed}
          scale={{ min: 0, max: 160, tickInterval: 20 }}
          ranges={speedRanges}
          valueFormat={kmh}
          title="Speed"
          style={{ height: 240 }}
        />
        <OgeCircularGauge
          value={cpu}
          indicator="bar"
          ranges={cpuRanges}
          startAngle={-90}
          endAngle={90}
          valueFormat={percent}
          title="CPU"
          style={{ height: 240 }}
        />
        <OgeCircularGauge
          value={cpu}
          indicator="marker"
          subvalues={[40, 85]}
          startAngle={-135}
          endAngle={135}
          title="Load"
          style={{ height: 240 }}
        />
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={randomize}>New reading</button>
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Series types

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const data = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => ({
  day: i + 1,
  smooth: Math.sin(i / 2) * 30 + 60,
  lo: Math.sin(i / 2) * 12 + 22,
  hi: Math.sin(i / 2) * 12 + 42,
  dots: Math.cos(i / 1.5) * 25 + 55,
  weight: (i % 5) + 1,
}));

const series: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'rangeBar', value1Field: 'lo', value2Field: 'hi', name: 'Band' },
  { type: 'stepLine', valueField: 'smooth', name: 'Steps', width: 2.5 },
  {
    type: 'bubble',
    valueField: 'dots',
    sizeField: 'weight',
    name: 'Bubbles',
    opacity: 0.75,
  },
];

export function SeriesTypes() {
  return (
    // Sixteen series types share one engine: line/spline/step lines, five
    // area flavors, four bar flavors (incl. rangeBar spanning value1..value2),
    // scatter, bubble (sizeField drives the AREA of each bubble), rangeArea
    // and candlestick. showLabels prints SI-formatted values next to small
    // series; null values become gaps, never fake zeros. Hovering a legend
    // item spotlights its series.
    <OgeChart
      dataSource={data}
      series={series}
      commonSeries={{ argumentField: 'day' }}
      style={{ height: 380 }}
    />
  );
}
```

#### Selection, i18n & export

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartHandle, OgeChartPointEvent, OgeChartPointRef, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const data = [
  { month: 'Jan', value: 12 },
  { month: 'Feb', value: 31 },
  { month: 'Mar', value: 24 },
  { month: 'Apr', value: 42 },
];

const series: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'bar', argumentField: 'month', valueField: 'value', name: 'Value' },
];

export function SelectableChart() {
  // App-wide: wrap the tree in
  // <OgeChartsConfigProvider config={{ locale: 'de', a11yTableLimit: 100 }}>
  const chart = useRef<OgeChartHandle>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<readonly OgeChartPointRef[]>([]);
  const lastPoint = useRef<OgeChartPointEvent | null>(null);

  /** The exporter loads lazily and needs no third-party library at all. */
  const exportPng = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToPng } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image');
    if (chart.current) await exportChartToPng(chart.current, { filename: 'chart.png' });
  };
  const exportSvg = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToSvg } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image');
    if (chart.current) exportChartToSvg(chart.current, { filename: 'chart.svg' });
  };
  return (
    <>
      {/* selectionMode="point" rings clicked points (Ctrl adds); onLegendClick
          is cancelable. Every user-facing string, aria included, lives in
          OgeChartsMessages (OgeChartsConfigProvider, locale). The
          dependency-free export entry serializes the SVG with inlined styles —
          PNG via canvas rasterization, or the standalone .svg itself. */}
      <div className="mb-2 flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportPng()}>Export PNG</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportSvg()}>Export SVG</button>
      </div>
      <OgeChart
        ref={chart}
        dataSource={data}
        series={series}
        selectionMode="point"
        selectedPoints={selected}
        onSelectedPointsChange={setSelected}
        locale="de"
        onPointClick={(event) => {
          lastPoint.current = event;
        }}
        style={{ height: 340 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Zoom, pan & tooltips

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartRange, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const data = Array.from({ length: 50_000 }, (_, i) => ({
  t: new Date(2026, 0, 1, 0, i * 15),
  cpu: 40 + Math.sin(i / 60) * 25 + (i % 13),
  memory: 55 + Math.cos(i / 90) * 18 + (i % 7),
}));

const series: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'line', argumentField: 't', valueField: 'cpu', name: 'CPU' },
  { type: 'line', argumentField: 't', valueField: 'memory', name: 'Memory' },
];

export function ServerLoad() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<OgeChartRange | null>(null);
  return (
    // 50,000 points per series stay fluid: paths auto-downsample with LTTB
    // (Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets — peaks survive) to roughly one point per
    // pixel, hit-testing is a binary search over the FULL data and pointer work
    // is rAF-coalesced. Wheel zooms around the cursor, dragging selects a
    // range, Shift+drag pans, Escape resets; visualRange is controlled; shared
    // tooltips list every series.
    <OgeChart
      dataSource={data}
      series={series}
      visualRange={range}
      onVisualRangeChange={setRange}
      zoomEnabled="both"
      panEnabled
      tooltip={{ shared: true }}
      crosshair={{ horizontal: true }}
      style={{ height: 380 }}
    />
  );
}
```

#### Range selector


#### Funnel & pyramid

```ts
  { group: '25–44', people: 2480 },
  { group: '45–64', people: 2110 },
  { group: '65+', people: 1380 },
];

export function Funnels() {
  return (
    // Stages sized by value; the tooltip, the announcement and the sr table
    // carry the conversion rates. Arrow keys walk the stages, Enter selects.
    <>
      <OgeFunnelChart
        dataSource={pipeline}
        argumentField="stage"
        valueField="count"
        neckWidth={0.2}
        label={{ position: 'outside' }}
        title="Sales pipeline"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
      <OgeFunnelChart
        dataSource={ages}
        argumentField="group"
        valueField="people"
        type="pyramid"
        algorithm="dynamicHeight"
        sortData={false}
        title="Population (thousands)"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

#### Heatmap

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeHeatmap } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartColorScale } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const tickets = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].flatMap((day, d) =>
  ['08', '10', '12', '14', '16', '18', '20', '22'].map((hour, h) => ({
    day,
    hour,
    tickets: Math.round(14 + 26 * Math.sin(((h + 1) / 8) * Math.PI) * (d < 5 ? 1 : 0.45) + ((d * 7 + h * 3) % 9)),
  })),
);

const change = ['North', 'East', 'South', 'West'].flatMap((region, r) =>
  ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'].map((quarter, q) => ({ region, quarter, change: ((r * 5 + q * 7) % 13) - 6 })),
);

// three stops make a diverging scale; theme tokens follow the theme
const diverging: OgeChartColorScale = {
  min: -6,
  max: 6,
  colors: ['var(--oge-danger)', 'var(--oge-bg)', 'var(--oge-success)'],
};

const signed = (value: number) => (value > 0 ? `+${value}` : String(value));

export function Heatmaps() {
  return (
    // Focus the grid: arrows move the active cell (Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End,
    // PageUp/PageDown too); screen readers get a real two-dimensional table.
    <>
      <OgeHeatmap
        dataSource={tickets}
        xField="hour"
        yField="day"
        valueField="tickets"
        title="Support tickets by hour"
        style={{ height: 340 }}
      />
      <OgeHeatmap
        dataSource={change}
        xField="quarter"
        yField="region"
        valueField="change"
        colorScale={diverging}
        valueFormat={signed}
        title="Change vs last year (%)"
        style={{ height: 260 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## @oge-ui/react-grid

React data grid: data-driven columns with render props, multi-column sorting, a typed filter row with an operator menu, global search, paging, row and column virtualization, windowed remote loading, single/multiple/checkbox selection, Excel-like keyboard navigation, grouping with summaries and deferred groups, master-detail, row render props, row drag, pinned/resizable/reorderable columns, state persistence and CSV export — running the same framework-free grid engine, state slices and stylesheet as the Angular grid package.

Docs: https://www.ogeui.com/components/data-grid

### <OgeGrid>

#### Properties

_Data & columns_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `readonly T[] \| DataSource<T>` | `[]` | Rows to render: a static array or any `DataSource` implementation (remote, windowed, pushing live changes). An array (or a source with `loadSync`) loads in the first render, so `renderToString` already contains the first page; asynchronous sources load after mount. |
| `columns` | `readonly (string \| OgeColumnDef \| OgeGridColumnProps<T>)[]` | `undefined` | The columns. When omitted, columns are derived from the first row’s keys; a plain string is shorthand for `{ field }`. |
| `keyField` | `keyof T \| ((row: T) => RowKey)` | `undefined` | Field (or selector) producing a stable row key; falls back to the row index. |

_Sorting, filtering & search_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sortable` | `boolean \| 'single' \| 'multi'` | `'multi'` | `false` disables sorting entirely; `'single'` restricts to one column (no shift+click chains). |
| `sorting` | `OgeSortingOptions` | `undefined` | Sorting options (`mode`, `allowUnsorting`); overrides the `sortable` shorthand. |
| `filterRow` | `boolean \| OgeFilterRowOptions` | `false` | Per-column filter editors below the header — text, number, date, boolean and lookup editors with a per-column operator menu. |
| `headerFilter` | `boolean \| OgeHeaderFilterOptions` | `false` | Excel-style distinct-value filter button in the headers. Needs a DataSource that implements `distinct()`; date columns list their values grouped by year. |
| `filterPanel` | `boolean` | `false` | Filter summary bar above the grid; clicking it opens the visual filter builder (arbitrary and/or condition trees). |
| `filterValue / defaultFilterValue` | `FilterExpr \| null` | `null` | The filter-builder expression — controlled with `onFilterValueChange`. Combines with the filter row, the header filters and the search panel. |
| `searchPanel` | `boolean \| OgeSearchPanelOptions` | `false` | Global search box above the grid. |
| `filterDebounce` | `number` | `config.filterDebounce (300)` | Debounce for text filter inputs, in ms. Set to `0` in tests. |
| `announcements` | `boolean` | `config.announcements (true)` | Speaks sort, filter/search result count (debounced, once the new result arrived), page, group expansion, select-all and blocked-save validation changes through the shared `useOgeLiveAnnouncer` regions — texts from the `*Announcement` messages. `false` opts out. |

_Paging & scrolling_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paging` | `false \| OgePagingOptions` | `false` | Enables paging with the pager: `pageSize`, optional `pageSizes`, `showInfo` and `displayMode`. |
| `virtualScroll` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders only the rows inside the scroll viewport (plus overscan). Give the grid a bounded height when enabled. |
| `scrolling` | `OgeScrollingOptions` | `undefined` | `mode` (`'virtual'` / `'infinite'`), `remote` windowed block loading and `columnRenderingMode: 'virtual'`; overrides the `virtualScroll` shorthand. |
| `rowHeight` | `number` | `config.rowHeight (36)` | Fixed row height in px used by the virtualizer. |
| `autoRowHeight` | `boolean` | `false` | Measures real row heights (wrapped text, render props) instead of forcing `rowHeight`, with scroll anchoring. Virtual mode only. |
| `overscan` | `number` | `config.overscan (6)` | Extra rows rendered above/below the virtual window. |
| `detailRowHeight` | `number` | `config.detailRowHeight (200)` | Height assumed for expanded master-detail rows in virtual mode. |

_Grouping_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groupPanel` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the drop area for drag-and-drop row grouping; each group renders as a removable chip. Keyboard: the header context menu (Shift+F10) offers `groupByColumn` / `ungroupColumn`; on a chip’s remove button Ctrl+←/→ reorders the grouping and Delete removes it (`messages.groupMoved` / `groupRemoved`). |
| `groupBy` | `readonly string[]` | `undefined` | Initial/programmatic grouping by field names (also drivable via the group panel). |
| `grouping` | `OgeGroupingOptions` | `undefined` | `autoExpandAll: false` starts every group collapsed and enables deferred loading (`items: null` payloads fetched on expand); `contextMenuEnabled: true` offers group/ungroup in the header menu without the group panel. |

_Selection & focus_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple' \| 'checkbox' \| 'cell'` | `'none'` | Row selection: single, multiple (ctrl/shift ranges, Ctrl+A) or a checkbox column with a select-all header — or `'cell'`: rectangular cell ranges with TSV copy / paste and the fill handle (editing then starts on double-click, F2 or Enter). |
| `selectedKeys / defaultSelectedKeys` | `readonly RowKey[]` | `[]` | The selected row keys — controlled with `selectedKeys` + `onSelectedKeysChange`, or seeded once with `defaultSelectedKeys`. |
| `selectionDeferred` | `boolean` | `false` | Deferred selection: the selection is an expression rather than a key set, so "select all" over a remote source never materializes keys. Requires a string `keyField`. |
| `selectionFilter` | `FilterExpr \| null` | `null` | The selection expression (deferred mode) — controlled with `onSelectionFilterChange`. |
| `selectAllMode` | `'allPages' \| 'page'` | `'allPages'` | Header select-all scope: the whole filtered set across pages, or only the rows on the current page. |
| `focusedRowEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Highlights and tracks a single focused row. |
| `focusedRowKey` | `RowKey \| null` | `undefined` | The focused row’s key — controlled when provided, with `onFocusedRowKeyChange`. |

_Columns UX_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columnMinWidth` | `number` | `config.columnMinWidth (120)` | Track minimum for columns without an explicit width. |
| `columnHidingMode` | `'hide' \| 'detail' \| undefined` | `config: 'detail'` | What happens to columns responsive hiding (`hidingPriority`) takes out on a narrow grid: `'detail'` gives every row a toggle (a real button with `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`, labelled by `toggleAdaptiveDetail`) that reveals the hidden columns' caption / value pairs on a second line of the row, rendered like the cells — format, lookups, boolean words and `renderCell`; `'hide'` drops them with no way back. The hiding pass counts the toggle's 32px track once a column is hidden. |
| `columnResize` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables drag-resize handles on header edges. Keyboard: Alt+←/→ on a focused header resizes by 10px (Shift for 1px); the handle is a focusable `role="separator"` (`aria-valuenow/min/max` = width in px, named by `messages.resizeColumn`) taking ←/→, Home/End (min / max) and Enter/Esc (back to the header). RTL-aware; clamped to `minWidth` / `maxWidth`. |
| `columnReorder` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables drag-and-drop column reordering (headers dropped onto each other). Keyboard: Ctrl+Shift+←/→ on a focused header moves the column one step, never across a pinned group or out of its band (an unbanded column steps over a band as a whole), announced via `messages.columnMoved`. |
| `columnChooser` | `boolean` | `false` | Toolbar button opening the show/hide column list; with `columnReorder` its rows also drag to reorder. Keyboard: Space toggles an item; with `columnReorder`, Ctrl+↑/↓ moves it. Hiding is also in the header context menu. |
| `toolbarBefore / toolbarCenter / toolbarAfter` | `ReactNode` | `undefined` | Your own toolbar content by group — the React form of Angular’s `[ogeToolbar]` placement: `toolbarBefore` at the start edge ahead of the group panel (filters, primary actions), `toolbarCenter` in the middle, `toolbarAfter` ahead of the built-in tools. Any of them makes the toolbar render. |

_Editing & rows_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `editing` | `false \| OgeEditingOptions` | `false` | Enables editing: `{ mode: 'cell' \| 'row' \| 'batch' \| 'popup' \| 'form', allowUpdating, allowAdding, allowDeleting, confirmDelete, formItems, formColCount }`. `form` replaces the row with an inline `<OgeForm>`; `popup` opens the same form in a modal. An invalid cell editor sets `aria-invalid` on its control and points `aria-errormessage` / `aria-describedby` at a rendered, visually hidden error text (also the cell’s tooltip); the `form`/`popup` fields wire the same through `<OgeForm>`. |
| `commandButtons` | `readonly OgeCommandButton<T>[]` | `undefined` | Customizes the trailing command column: reorder or mix the built-in `'edit'` / `'delete'` buttons with your own. Omitted, the column shows the built-ins the `editing` permissions allow. |
| `highlightChanges` | `boolean` | `false` | Briefly flashes cells whose value changed under a live-updating source; consecutive updates to one cell restart the animation. |
| `rowDragging` | `boolean` | `false` | Drag-handle column for reordering rows. With plain-array data the array is mutated in place; DataSource consumers handle `onRowReordered` instead. Keyboard: Ctrl+↑/↓ on a focused cell moves the row onto its neighbour through the same drop path (same event), announced via `messages.rowMoved`. |
| `renderRow` | `(context: OgeGridRowRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | `undefined` | Replaces the whole data row — the React form of `*ogeRowTemplate`. Group, detail and summary rows keep their built-in rendering. |
| `renderDetail` | `(context: OgeGridDetailRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | `undefined` | Master-detail content under an expanded row — the React form of `*ogeDetailTemplate`. Its presence adds the expander column and switches the role to `treegrid`. |

_Appearance & misc_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stateKey` | `string` | `undefined` | Persists user state (sort, filters, column layout, page size) under this key via the state storage (default `localStorage`) and restores it on mount. |
| `stateStorage` | `OgeStateStorage` | `context storage` | Per-grid storage backend; overrides `<OgeGridStateStorageProvider>`. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeGridMessages>` | `undefined` | Per-grid overrides of the UI strings (see `<OgeGridConfigProvider>` for app-wide). |
| `locale` | `string` | `undefined` | BCP 47 locale of the grid’s formatted text — default date cells, declarative column `format`s, summaries, group captions, header-filter values, the filter row’s number parsing and editors, clipboard parsing and exported text — and of its plural-aware messages. `undefined` falls back to `<OgeGridConfigProvider config={{ locale }}>`, then `navigator.language`. |
| `loadPanel` | `boolean` | `false` | Spinner overlay while a load is in flight. |
| `wordWrap` | `boolean` | `false` | Wraps cell text instead of clipping it. |
| `rowAlternation` | `boolean` | `false` | Alternating row background (zebra striping), stable under virtualization. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Right-to-left layout. `undefined` auto-detects the inherited CSS `direction`; `true`/`false` force it. |
| `renderNoData` | `(context: OgeGridNoDataContext) => ReactNode` | `undefined` | Renders the empty state instead of the `noData` message — the React form of `*ogeNoDataTemplate`. |
| `className / style / ariaLabel` | `string \| CSSProperties` | `undefined` | Host class, inline style (give the grid its height here) and the accessible name of the grid. |

_Cells, ranges & clipboard_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rangeSelection` | `OgeRangeSelectionOptions` | `—` | `{ copyHeaders, fillHandle, pasteAddsRows, multipleRanges }`. |
| `selectedRanges / defaultSelectedRanges` | `readonly OgeGridCellRange[]` | `—` | The selected ranges — controlled with `selectedRanges` + `onSelectedRangesChange`, or seeded once. A sort, filter, page or grouping change clears them. |
| `pinnedTopRows` | `readonly (T \| RowKey)[]` | `—` | Rows pinned in a sticky section under the header: data objects, or keys of loaded rows (which then leave the body). Display rows; virtual scrolling compatible. |
| `pinnedBottomRows` | `readonly (T \| RowKey)[]` | `—` | Rows pinned in the sticky footer, above the total row. |
| `stickyGroupRows` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the enclosing group rows under the header while scrolling — a visual aid; a click scrolls to the group. |
| `cellSpan` | `(row: T, column: OgeGridColumnInfo) => OgeGridCellSpan \| null \| undefined` | `—` | Row / column spans per cell, with `aria-rowspan` / `aria-colspan` and span-aware arrows. Ignored while virtualized. |
| `columnAutoWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Sizes every column to its content once the first result set rendered. |
| `cellHintEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows truncated cell text in the overlay tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus. |

_Styling & drag groups_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rowClass` | `(row: T, key: RowKey) => OgeClassValue` | `—` | Classes for a data row — string, array or `{ class: condition }` record. |
| `cellClass` | `(row: T, column: OgeGridColumnInfo) => OgeClassValue` | `—` | Classes for a data cell, per row and column. |
| `rowDragGroup` | `string` | `—` | Grids sharing a group name accept each other’s dragged rows; the target’s `onRowDrop` carries the source row. The source needs `rowDragging`. |
| `allowDropInsideRow` | `boolean` | `false` | A drop on the middle half of a row reports `position: 'inside'`. |
| `renderPagerInfo` | `(context: OgePagerInfoContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Renders the pager’s info text — the React form of `*ogePagerInfoTemplate`. |
| `id` | `string` | `—` | Host element id — also the component id the row-drag events report. |

#### Methods

_Data & view_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `refresh(): void` | `handle` | Re-runs the current load against the DataSource. |
| `getVisibleRows(): readonly T[]` | `handle` | Data rows of the currently rendered page, in display order. |
| `getRowByKey(key: RowKey): T \| undefined` | `handle` | The loaded row carrying `key`, if it is currently rendered. |
| `totalCount(): number` | `handle` | Data row count of the current filtered set, across all pages. |

_Navigation & expansion_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scrollToRow(target: number \| RowKey): void` | `handle` | Scrolls a row into the viewport — by flat index, or by row key. |
| `navigateToRow(key: RowKey): void` | `handle` | Scrolls the row carrying `key` into view and, with `focusedRowEnabled`, makes it the focused row. |
| `expandRow(key) / collapseRow(key)` | `handle` | Expands or collapses a group row (by its group node key, e.g. `g:Sales`) or a master-detail row. |
| `isRowExpanded(key): boolean` | `handle` | Whether the group or master-detail row carrying `key` is expanded. |
| `expandAllGroups() / collapseAllGroups()` | `handle` | Expands or collapses every group row, all levels. |

_Selection_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectAll(): void` | `handle` | Selects every row of the current filtered set; scope via `selectAllMode`. |
| `deselectAll() / clearSelection()` | `handle` | Clears the selection (parity aliases). |
| `isRowSelected(key): boolean` | `handle` | Whether the row carrying `key` is selected. |
| `getSelectedRowsData(): T[]` | `handle` | Data of the selected rows among the currently loaded rows, in display order. |
| `copyToClipboard(): Promise<void>` | `handle` | Copies the selected rows (with a header) — or, without a selection, the focused cell’s text — as tab-separated values. Also on Ctrl+C. |

_Paging_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pageIndex(): number / setPageIndex(index)` | `handle` | Reads or navigates to the zero-based page (clamped to the valid range). |
| `pageSize(): number / setPageSize(size)` | `handle` | Reads or changes the page size; `0` turns paging off. |
| `pageCount(): number` | `handle` | Number of pages; `1` when paging is off. |

_Columns & summaries_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showColumnChooser(anchor?) / hideColumnChooser()` | `handle` | Opens the column chooser below `anchor` — e.g. a button in your own header bar, with `columnChooser` off — or, without one, below its toolbar button (or the grid’s start edge) / closes it. |
| `getTotalSummaryValue(field, type?)` | `handle` | Raw value of a `totalSummary` by field (and type, when a column has several); `undefined` when none is configured or data has not loaded. |

_Loading, state & export_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `beginCustomLoading(message?) / endCustomLoading()` | `handle` | Shows the load panel with an optional custom message, independent of data-source activity. |
| `state(): GridStateSnapshot / applyState(snapshot)` | `handle` | Reads or applies the persistable UI state: sort, filters, column layout, page size. `applyState` validates the snapshot first (`sanitize*StateSnapshot`): unknown keys are dropped, prototype keys rejected, wrong types skipped — invalid input is ignored, never thrown. |
| `clearFilters() / clearSorting()` | `handle` | Clears every filter (row filters and search) / the sort order. |
| `getExportData(options?): Promise<OgeExportData<T>>` | `handle` | Rows, column metadata (width, alignment, pin side, band) and the structured lines — group rows, group footers, the total row (`items`) — of the current view (filter + search + sort applied). `scope: 'all' \| 'page' \| 'selection'` (or `selectedRowsOnly`), `visibleColumnsOnly: false` adds hidden columns, `groups` / `summaries: false` export flat. |
| `getCsv(options?): Promise<string>` | `handle` | Builds CSV of the current view; `customizeCell` rewrites individual cells.Cells a spreadsheet would evaluate as a formula are apostrophe-prefixed (CSV formula injection); `formulaGuard: false` opts out. |
| `exportCsv(filename = 'grid.csv', options?): Promise<void>` | `handle` | Downloads the current view as a CSV file. Fires the cancelable `onExporting` first. `options` are `getCsv()`’s (`scope`, `customizeCell`, `separator`…); formula-leading cells are always neutralized. |

_Editing_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addRow(): void` | `handle` | Adds an empty draft row on top and opens its editor(s); requires `editing.allowAdding`. `onInitNewRow` prefills it. |
| `editRow(key): void` | `handle` | Opens the row editor for `key` — effective in `row`, `form` and `popup` modes; requires `editing.allowUpdating`. |
| `deleteRow(key): void` | `handle` | Staged in batch mode (toggles, undoable), applied immediately otherwise; requires `editing.allowDeleting`. |
| `saveChanges(): void` | `handle` | Commits the open editor and, in batch mode, saves the whole staged change set. `onSavingChanges` can still cancel it. |
| `discardChanges(): void` | `handle` | Drops every pending change and closes any open editor; fires `onEditCanceled` when anything was open or pending. |
| `hasChanges(): boolean` | `handle` | Whether unsaved edits exist: staged changes, added or removed rows. |

_Ranges, clipboard & undo_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectRange(range, add?)` | `(range: OgeGridCellRange, add?: boolean) => void` | Selects a rectangular cell range; `add` keeps the existing ones. |
| `clearRangeSelection()` | `() => void` | Clears every cell range. |
| `getSelectedRangeData()` | `() => unknown[][]` | The selected cells’ values as a rows × columns matrix (the lattice Ctrl+C copies). |
| `pasteText(text)` | `(text: string) => Promise<number>` | Pastes a TSV block into the editable cells from the focused cell (or fills the selected range with a single value): parsed with the column data type and lookup, validated, written as one undoable batch through the regular edit events. Resolves with the cells written. |
| `fillDown() / fillRight()` | `() => Promise<number>` | Ctrl+D / Ctrl+R: copies the range’s first row (column) into the rest — a single row copies the row above it. |
| `undo() / redo()` | `() => Promise<void>` | Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: reverts or re-applies the last committed edit, paste or fill (staged in batch mode, saved otherwise). |
| `canUndo() / canRedo()` | `() => boolean` | Whether the history has a step to revert / re-apply. |
| `autoFitColumn(field) / autoFitColumns()` | `(field: string) => void` | Sizes a column (or every column) to its header and rendered cells — what a double-click on the resize handle and the header menu’s “Size to fit” run. |

Push entries into `items` to open the grid’s own menu; leave it empty and the browser’s native menu is left alone. `source` is `'pointer'` or `'keyboard'` (then `clientX/Y` is the cell’s start/bottom corner); `event` is the originating React event. |
| `onHeaderContextMenu` | `(event: OgeHeaderContextMenuEvent) => void` | Right-click on a header — or the Menu key / Shift+F10 on a focused header — with the built-in items (sort / group / pin / hide) prebuilt: add, remove or reorder them before the menu opens. | `onRowCollapsing` | `(event: OgeGridRowTogglingEvent<T>) => void` | Before a group or master-detail row collapses; cancelable. |
| `onRowCollapsed` | `(event: OgeGridRowToggleEvent<T>) => void` | After a group or master-detail row collapsed. |
| `onSelectedKeysChange / onFocusedRowKeyChange` | `(value) => void` | The controlled-pair callbacks of `selectedKeys` and `focusedRowKey`. |

_Editing_

| Name | Type | Description |

| `onRowInserting / onRowInserted` | `(event) => void` | Around an added row reaching the DataSource; the `-ing` half is cancelable. |
| `onRowUpdating / onRowUpdated` | `(event) => void` | Around an edited row reaching the DataSource; the `-ing` half is cancelable and carries the change set. |

| `onSavingChanges / onSavedChanges` | `(event) => void` | Around a save batch: the `-ing` half is cancelable and can rewrite the change list; the past-tense half reports what was applied. |

| `onFilterValueChange / onSelectionFilterChange` | `(value: FilterExpr \| null) => void` | The controlled halves of `filterValue` (filter builder) and `selectionFilter` (deferred selection). |
